---
| | On Saturday, an assassination attempt on President Trump shook us all to our core.
This horrific act is unacceptable in our great country. We must do better. Jackie and I are praying for President Trump and all of the victims during this difficult time.
I am grateful for the fast actions by the Secret Service and other first responders for their quick action which prevented further violence.
Now we must all work together to unite the country. Yours,

subject: let’s avoid WWIII

body:
The Uniparty can say what they want about me, but at least they know where I stand on never-ending wars.| | | Please see a note from our sponsors. If you would like to unsubscribe, please visit this _[link.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_s=6961c69ac5bb46eba5dfe1bb4525c01d&_t=hfpbE8VxYJK9JL1XVfTPdleUr3BQq5pgpNtNVNM4_UY-aPoh6DpWaaUtl24Ao50Um4uKow1ZTKezky2iOsGhULRV8h18tYnUwuc6xrIvCM9mOi0DXqe3DIHIDsPVgx_Y)_
---
Peter, Some in my own party have referred to me as an “isolationist.” Some have said I will _never_ approve of going to war, even if it means fighting for our values abroad. I’ve said since I began public life that I look at the world, and consider war, realistically and constitutionally.

I still see war as the last resort. But I agree with Reagan’s idea that no country should mistake U.S. reluctance for war for a lack of resolve. Peter, my opposition to funding the never-ending war in Ukraine stems from two concerns: **1\. How does America benefit?** We get nothing out of sending billions and billions of dollars on a conflict that doesn’t involve us. **2\. Our national debt.** We’re spending $1.5 trillion every three months – and we’re literally borrowing money from China to send overseas to Ukraine when we can’t even afford our own bills. Americans are tired of Washington elites spending their hard-earned money on never-ending wars that bring us closer to the brink of WWIII while bankrupting our nation. _**_[_**_I AGREE >>_**_](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=6961c69ac5bb46eba5dfe1bb4525c01d&_e=XebAQ0KzFrcnYg31kWN9tn5fqvlgg21w-bvedWRAOZTOEhTAEVRXhdKkQmDoH0w13sP2FLCgo2npNBwCXBrVI3QzdbqEYBAD1T6767Ec88pPUHJ0xaF0wcqc7eotCEDWOFHNeYo5kRPMnXJwWZJoBd61X-5Eh9ikN175EyD8munE0seUPBS9qYLJbQJzmRomBQOEYhVV57imH-KNcv0g63M8OYAAitEWSRB7xAGuKOad84jacdTA4aru7tVoQzXKiYnKYzXa_dVcn1b_P2YcA9H1m0ciha5r9zz2noDlTXN1aJivMGYSvaLJBTjUyFVtD045BqNNKOptJPFXX-1vLHLXD908Nb36IMsZkFX-o3pMSWx_27NuAtf5rSEGmhtSsxkA7M2OttEZf5SaXZmq2feTxby5O0ZEyJ8-iwCz74A%3D)_**_

body:
Donald Trump just announced his running mate:
#
Derek, Donald Trump just announced his running mate: **JD Vance.**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240715?refcode=em20240715-9221&refcode2=9221_434096_KGW35H&akid=9221%2E434096%2EKGW35H)
This might come as a surprise but I actually agree with JD on a few things.
For instance, I agree with him when he called Trump a “cynical asshole” and when he said Trump is “unfit for our nation’s highest office.”
Besides that, though, **JD Vance stands for some pretty wild things**. In the Senate, Vance has voted against the Reproductive Freedom for Women Act and has claimed that the overturning of Roe v. Wade was a victory for our nation. 👎
Vance also has earned a 93% score of voting with the Heritage Action for America organization – the nice folks who are behind Project 2025. If elected as Vice President, he’s sure to further support Project 2025 in further restricting reproductive freedom, eliminating federal agencies, stripping away LGBTQ+ rights, mass-deportations and more despicable policy positions. 🙃
**There’s no doubt in anyone’s mind that a Trump/Vance presidential term would be damaging to our nation. We have to do _everything_ we can to make sure that President Biden and Vice President Harris get re-elected in November.**
**[If you are as committed as I am to President Biden and the good he has left to do as President, will you join me in making a $5 contribution to his campaign right now?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240715?refcode=em20240715-9221&refcode2=9221_434096_KGW35H&akid=9221%2E434096%2EKGW35H)**

President Biden and Vice President Harris have been working for the American people for the past four years; we NEED another four of their leadership to see things through.
❤️ John
John Fetterman
U.S. Senator from Pennsylvania

#### _The opinion piece below was originally published during the Summer of 2022 in the_**Concord Monitor** _when I was a Candidate for the US Senate. In light of the current political climate, including some of the campus chaos we 've witnessed during the Spring, I thought it might be useful to repost it. While it's slightly out of date, much of my thinking as described below remains relevant. The United States remains a land of opportunity, but polarization and division threaten our ability to fully realize America's true potential. It's time to focus on what we have in common rather than how we may be different._
### _-Vikram_
* * *
## Unify, Don't Separate, America
_Concord Monitor_ , August 3, 2022
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d56eff54-3466-49d0-ae86-9781cac13fbe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Having taught at Harvard for the past five years and Yale for the eight years prior to that, I've had a front-row seat to watch the evolution of our culture on campus. And let me be blunt, it's disturbing.
When I graduated from college, I remember commencement as a celebration of unity, a celebration that brought all together, regardless of religion, skin color or socioeconomic background. The graduation garb was the literal embodiment of commonality. We all wore the same robes, same graduation caps, and same tassels.
Today's graduations emphasize differences rather than similarities. It's now commonplace to have separate graduation ceremonies for students who identify differently. Harvard, for instance, doesn't have one graduation. This year there was a Black graduation, a Native American graduation, and a LatinX graduation (a term that Hispanics detest, by the way). There was also a FirstGen graduation, an APIDA graduation for Asian/Pacific Islander/Desi-Americans, and a Lavender graduation for the LGBTQ+ community.
And Harvard is not alone. This is a growing trend with colleges and universities around the country. Columbia had six "identity-focused" graduations, including an "FLI" graduation for first-generation college graduates and low-income students. Princeton had six, including a Women/Femme graduation and a Pan-African graduation. The list goes on.
Of course, it's not just about the multi-cultural graduations. This is just the tip of the iceberg when it comes to the "woke" ideology stomping its way through our institutions. The "new segregationists," mostly white elites, are reversing 50 years of progress by pushing for separate dorms and programs based upon ethnicity and race.
Scolds rail against "cultural appropriation" and tell us what foods we can eat or what music we can listen to; which actors and actresses can play which parts. [Holidays](https://substack.com/redirect/0488b418-f5a3-4482-9f3c-4b99514fb614?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) canceled in the name of "inclusivity" and "equity," and progressives [police](https://substack.com/redirect/b76bdbdc-25d0-4ac5-a00e-b4f40f9ddb96?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) our choice of Halloween costumes and even our [hairstyles](https://substack.com/redirect/fcc58b17-3848-40f8-87ea-a30c256087a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Our lexicon is now littered with words like "privilege," "implicit bias," and "problematic." Seminars push the [Privilege Pie](https://substack.com/redirect/d0be71f3-1ce7-44d2-be45-bf14764252a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [White Supremacy Pyramid](https://substack.com/redirect/5554dc4f-261d-47c8-b2dc-3297b69aaf30?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) while everyone is encouraged to find their place in the grievance hierarchy.
Meetings begin with cult-like incantations reminding participants the gathering is being held on "stolen land." Everything is white supremacy: showing up on time, working hard, or even using proper grammar. And saying that you believe America is a "melting pot" now makes you racist.
The American Revolution is being replaced by a Cultural Revolution, one that is upending U.S. history. Instead of America, however imperfect, being founded in 1776 in the name of liberty and rights, this Cultural Revolution now pushes 1619, when the first African slave landed in Virginia, as our real founding.
Revolutionaries encourage kneeling during the Star-Spangled Banner and push for alternative "national anthems" to be played before NFL games. Cornell recently removed a bust of Abraham Lincoln and a plaque of the Gettysburg Address from its library. There are calls to remove Washington's and Jefferson's names from schools and buildings. Books are being banned and bookshelves "decolonized." [Beethoven's](https://substack.com/redirect/8e277dd4-7217-4d32-9feb-a24e995890d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) music, they say, bolsters white males at the expense of women, minorities, and the LGBTQ+ community.
And while many proudly fly the stars and stripes outside of our homes, the Cultural Revolution marches through the streets under alternative flags and calls for the American flag to be [redesigned](https://substack.com/redirect/30c62792-5cf5-4a82-91af-5c6145fb5772?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
_The New York Times_ finds the American flag "[alienating](https://substack.com/redirect/39a1391e-5f21-4929-9167-81d9f3fd1864?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." One reporter was "[disturbed](https://substack.com/redirect/52319439-3702-47cf-ac80-5f67d0f2d393?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" to see so many American flags flying; another was bothered to see it carried by our athletes at the [Olympics](https://substack.com/redirect/f3ef2225-83f3-4d03-8ee5-b2fd058adf9c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
None of this is to say that the country is perfect. Racism, slavery, and Jim Crow are stains on our history, a betrayal of what America stands for. Liberal elites, however, think that is what America stands for. They think our country is irredeemably racist; that we have racism woven into our very DNA and that we must tear down our history, constitution, and democracy so it can be built anew.
History offers lessons we should heed. My parents were immigrants from India, fleeing violence after Partition. The British had divided the country in two, one for Hindus and one for Muslims, and overnight neighbor was set against neighbor.
Howling mobs prowled the streets, killing anyone who was different from them. At the time of Partition, Muhammad Jinnah, a Muslim, pushed for the creation of a separate Muslim homeland, while Mohandas Gandhi, a Hindu, fought to keep the country together.
Jinnah told Gandhi that when looking back on the sweep of history, the Muslims' heroes were the Hindus' villains, and the Hindus' heroes were the Muslims' villains. How could we be one country, he asked?
All countries and peoples need a common history and set of shared values. If we no longer share a common American identity, a common American story, with the same heroes and idols, are we destined to fray?
If we instead celebrate different holidays, fly different flags, and stand for different anthems, how can we remain one country? And if we can't agree that George Washington was the father of our nation and Abraham Lincoln a savior, what hope do we have for unity? It's time for Americans to unify around achieving the ideal of one nation, indivisible, with liberty and justice (and equality of opportunity) for all.
My parents say that the proudest day of their lives was the day they became Americans. I carry their nationalization papers with me as a reminder of their sacrifice and of how lucky I am to have been born in this country.
And my father, while proud of his heritage, doesn't need hyphens, made-up words, or an alphabet soup of acronyms to explain who he is. "I'm an American," he says.

At the time of Partition, Muhammad Jinnah, a Muslim, pushed for the creation of a separate Muslim homeland, while Mohandas Gandhi, a Hindu, fought to keep the country together. Jinnah told Gandhi that when looking back on the sweep of history, the Muslims' heroes were the Hindus' villains, and the Hindus' heroes were the Muslims' villains. How could we be one country, he asked? All countries and peoples need a common history and set of shared values. If we no longer share a common American identity, a common American story, with the same heroes and idols, are we destined to fray? If we instead celebrate different holidays, fly different flags, and stand for different anthems, how can we remain one country? And if we can't agree that George Washington was the father of our nation and Abraham Lincoln a savior, what hope do we have for unity? It's time for Americans to unify around achieving the ideal of one nation, indivisible, with liberty and justice (and equality of opportunity) for all. My parents say that the proudest day of their lives was the day they became Americans. I carry their nationalization papers with me as a reminder of their sacrifice and of how lucky I am to have been born in this country. And my father, while proud of his heritage, doesn't need hyphens, made-up words, or an alphabet soup of acronyms to explain who he is. "I'm an American," he says. | | ---|---|--- VIKRAM MANSHARAMANI is an entrepreneur, consultant, scholar, neighbor, husband, father, volunteer, and professional generalist who thinks in multiple-dimensions and looks beyond the short-term. Self-taught to think around corners and connect original dots, he spends his time speaking with global leaders in business, government, academia, and journalism. President Donald Trump appears at the RNC Convention with a bandage over his right ear days after an assassination attempt, on July 15, 2024. (NBC News).

By Illinois Review
On Monday night, former President Donald Trump – the Republican nominee for President, made an emotional appearance at the Republican National Convention in Milwaukee, wearing a bandage over his right ear after a bullet pierced through his skin during an assassination attempt on Saturday during a rally in Pennsylvania that killed one man and critically injured two others.

Trump’s entrance, captured live on the jumbotron as Lee Greenwood sang “God Bless the U.S.A.,” marked his first public appearance since Saturday’s tragic event, where he was rushed off the stage after several shots were fired in his direction by an assassin. Sadly, firefighter Corey Comperatore was killed protecting his family as his last words were, “Get down.” Two other rally attendees remain in the hospital with critical injuries.

Trump was struck in the right ear as Secret Service agents rushed the stage and used their own bodies as shields to protect the injured former president. As he stood up, blood was seen coming down the right side of his face. But to project calm during chaos, the former president began pumping his fist telling the audience to “fight, fight fight” as he stood underneath the American flag – in a visual that will live on as one of the most iconic images in our nation’s history.

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Are you ready for the end times?
body:
Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

| | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z7vftqj2u9gfctfnbbkii6jfnrk5p6gk8vf8gn48_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4chh62o36c5h2bs)
---
Hello Friend,

Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings, our Savior, will return.

That's the heart of Revelation.

Each day on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale. Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is near.

This isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about revealing Jesus Christ.

When Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns, that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's Revelation's essence.

As the great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of our King.

In my brand-new book, _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ , I tackle five common questions about the end times. We'll delve into:

1\. America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the Antichrist?
2\. The Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this apocalyptic event?
3\. The Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4\. Gog and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their appearance?
5\. The Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the unsure.

In addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative.
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z3sboj5qro8v0gahafrnvqna1fn501rhn9t71ua0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4chh62o36c5h2bs)I would like to send you my brand-new book _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ and my brand-new resource "The Major Characters of the End Times" as a thank you for your generous support of $10 or more to the ministry of _Pathway to Victory_.

Make your generous gift here: [https://secure.ptv.org/mysteries-of-the-end-times-generous-gift-1-dr-robert-jeffress](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zasmsip5nj2mrgvp6nr6if30820ijvrqv3juvh50_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4chh62o36c5h2bs)

_Pathway to Victory_ is committed to equipping believers with biblical teaching and reaching the unsaved by spreading the Good News of Jesus Christ through the most effective means available: radio, television, digital, and print. Your gifts fuel that important work and enable people worldwide to experience an intimate walk with Christ. Thank you for your faithful support.

May our study of Revelation prepare, strengthen, and inspire you. Come quickly, Lord Jesus.

Sharing the Truth of God's Word, ____
---
| | Dr. Robert Jeffress Senior Pastor, First Baptist Dallas

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Are you ready for the end times?
body:
Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

| | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zl0n89bse06nvnvr283dcnjimpucpvhqjc4cb6bg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4chh69ob4cph2bs)
---
Hello Friend,

Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings, our Savior, will return.

That's the heart of Revelation.

Each day on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale. Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is near.

This isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about revealing Jesus Christ.

When Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns, that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's Revelation's essence.

As the great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of our King.

In my brand-new book, _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ , I tackle five common questions about the end times. We'll delve into:

1\. America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the Antichrist?
2\. The Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this apocalyptic event?
3\. The Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4\. Gog and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their appearance?
5\. The Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the unsure.

In addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative.
[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zc7s5otq36v40a1a0qh3s4rm90hi8ctqsusdcpdg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4chh69ob4cph2bs)I would like to send you my brand-new book _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ and my brand-new resource "The Major Characters of the End Times" as a thank you for your generous support of $10 or more to the ministry of _Pathway to Victory_.

Make your generous gift here: [https://secure.ptv.org/mysteries-of-the-end-times-generous-gift-1-dr-robert-jeffress](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z5g7ee5if3stb9saj990eks4u322uu2o1hiecrq0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4chh69ob4cph2bs)

_Pathway to Victory_ is committed to equipping believers with biblical teaching and reaching the unsaved by spreading the Good News of Jesus Christ through the most effective means available: radio, television, digital, and print. Your gifts fuel that important work and enable people worldwide to experience an intimate walk with Christ. Thank you for your faithful support.

May our study of Revelation prepare, strengthen, and inspire you. Come quickly, Lord Jesus.

Sharing the Truth of God's Word, ____
---
| | Dr. Robert Jeffress Senior Pastor, First Baptist Dallas

name: Amanda Chase
subject: Why JD Vance is a Good Choice
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Amanda Chase
body:
Signals America is Back on the Right Track
| | | | JD VANCE WAS OUR TOP PICK FOR VICE PRESIDENT
---
---
| Friends, It's official. US Senator JD Vance from Ohio is President Trump's pick for Vice President.
JD Vance?
Many of you have texted or called me asking who is JD Vance and is this a good thing?
The answer is a resounding, yes.
Senator JD Vance was the top pick for many conservative across the country. And the fact that he was chosen over more well known Republicans like Senator Tim Scott and Senator Marco Rubio is a sign that President Trump isn't afraid to chose lesser known conservatives to assist him in governing and getting America back on track.
This is an interesting choice as JD Vance used to be a vocal critic of President Trump. Vance openly criticized Trump in 2016 as pundits used his memoir to explain the former president's popularity with white, rural voters. [He previously suggested](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001TTl0BmOW9Qf-7KKRrVP41gbebA4fAPlYkYJyhln7r3Ey2pFp_eZdHs0D8eakPJPXLRvizJr9iOFi5QjamI0PRJxD6U04-67syTIg70xZoUIUa6Mk4NEy-w-n8Ru2hzYgbO0PRcFUajpr6B0LxA7_c_x-YgEGgi2NrZXIF-8U-QnEB4xDyJsg5RumbbmVsso7U1AyijH1Yyfu4Mb4zCvMlPfJsXvFznng8O2dYOtaEABbuSd8Q0gSJdDFLrxrOSyTG5nfy8H0PkT2M77fdvLlL5fbQI3zMsm382-j3OGZcfY=&c=LC6JHnCJ3FdUo3S2hlifvIUv560R2TO_xq5BgOr_cMAmY9vLv_u26A==&ch=ojVFQ1NG0NZcUjtJNrtnmhqc0yPxj1WMqui9wFuGWbm1Ps5Z2YUQFA==) Trump could be "America's Hitler," called him noxious and compared him to an opioid.
But Vance changed his tune as he geared up for his 2022 Senate run, deleting controversial tweets and crediting Trump for the work he did in office. He secured Trump's endorsement in a chaotic Republican Senate primary and is now one of the former president's most loyal allies.
Vance should appeal to working-class voters, which is essential to winning the key battleground states in a poor Rust Belt town in Ohio. Vance's childhood was marked by poverty and abuse, and his mother struggled with drug addiction. Vance and his sister Lindsey were raised primarily by his maternal grandparents. So many can relate to him.

The Cook Report, which rates federal races across the country, has updated its ratings for this seat!
Michigan has gone "lean Democrat" to "toss-up."
This new rating makes it even more important for us to win this Primary. As you know, we have been told that we must nominate a moderate Republican to win in November. The seat is now a "toss-up" which means a conservative can win.
Biden is sinking the Democrat ticket. Whether it is his cognitive issues or his terrible policies, people are going to vote Republican in November! This is our opportunity to put our nation on the right path. The biggest mistake we could make is nominating a Republican who will sell us out. And as you know, Senate terms are 6 years so there is no do-over!
We must win this race.
If you care about protecting your rights, stopping inflation, balancing the budget, and securing our border, then I need your help during the final weeks of this campaign. Can I count on you?

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Are you ready for the end times?
body:
It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

| | | [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b1242d522bbb4fd1b721dcf2c7c019fa&_e=LTtYhAxuzTwfdz7wOKeYn5FZznbuVnIAxq2PJAOnExkePbei8owqBgcru9HG7mA-yxVasJxYxGT7nNGxe1YQTGCLNOEtGpFHGIwD35FMX66PVeiWwiQfBpX5zZhsGAAA_a8FxfAP2LQdbAjuwZnlAbA0tdGvHNBo15qAC9xUJW_m0t-3qqOdIXF73FvdkYkOL9EQ95llHfp3uaviPW4n9Mcl-qaaujcFH6AKDeFoAnqc6bv-38B2G_ZlMy6L3dTug5Bsrn6fOUyBwSL4g6W06XgHJCScKdLhn7F14SqBPby6Po5U28jhiqzETEtVvfnJqFLml3Mi3J-L62ZErQTtVGYCsCex74r8rJTXXu_Sgx4O72YeNzFCIW4SQT19rQ90UHJ2Xr4Xp47oi12yd1Q0eRsuozb1WVFx9ST3YadVSSGSdi17DLoDDmqnskrU54ls)
---
Hello Friend,

Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings, our Savior, will return.

That's the heart of Revelation.

Each day on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale. Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is near.

This isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about revealing Jesus Christ.

When Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns, that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's Revelation's essence.

As the great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of our King.

In my brand-new book, _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ , I tackle five common questions about the end times. We'll delve into:

1\. America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the Antichrist?
2\. The Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this apocalyptic event?
3\. The Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4\. Gog and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their appearance?
5\. The Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the unsure.

In addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative. [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b1242d522bbb4fd1b721dcf2c7c019fa&_e=LTtYhAxuzTwfdz7wOKeYn5FZznbuVnIAxq2PJAOnExkePbei8owqBgcru9HG7mA-yxVasJxYxGT7nNGxe1YQTGCLNOEtGpFHGIwD35FMX66PVeiWwiQfBpX5zZhsGAAA_a8FxfAP2LQdbAjuwZnlAbA0tdGvHNBo15qAC9xUJW_m0t-3qqOdIXF73FvdkYkOL9EQ95llHfp3uaviPW4n9Mcl-qaaujcFH6AKDeFoAnqc6bv-38B2G_ZlMy6L3dTug5Bsrn6fOUyBwSL4g6W06T9hGUa-0Fj60L5whB5WlAOfTP9bPv6gHsznmQCpM4dQ3IeHvTVA-E1YTv6zgNqdlViJ3pXK0_HBGsLyc-Dg5Vkf0JaimqclLTCIryT-ju_B3r0fibynG0hskfDxi-B4qVF5dSo6RKgAELsfDoA3w8bUcV3JhdzWVeKlkwxqnL6v) I would like to send you my brand-new book _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ and my brand-new resource "The Major Characters of the End Times" as a thank you for your generous support of $10 or more to the ministry of _Pathway to Victory_.

Make your generous gift here: [https://secure.ptv.org/mysteries-of-the-end-times-generous-gift-1-dr-robert-jeffress](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b1242d522bbb4fd1b721dcf2c7c019fa&_e=LTtYhAxuzTwfdz7wOKeYn5FZznbuVnIAxq2PJAOnExkePbei8owqBgcru9HG7mA-yxVasJxYxGT7nNGxe1YQTGCLNOEtGpFHGIwD35FMX66PVeiWwiQfBpX5zZhsGAAA_a8FxfAP2LQdbAjuwZnlAbA0tdGvHNBo15qAC9xUJW_m0t-3qqOdIXF73FvdkYkOL9EQ95llHfp3uaviPW4n9Mcl-qaaujcFH6AKDeFoAnqc6bv-38B2G_ZlMy6L3dTug5Bsrn6fOUyBwSL4g6W06UHve_8oAK1tTwF4XO4tl1ZzKQ41hNdlwYu3bOm7BkMCeM5tzpyg8Yj1F40vRALPtSGD0dXfMvCO1hYyUVWA2Zrb2OYJ3xyIWbAowcds6n0PsDTdgVAtir7yI25PoWpPcQNfEhw6zC6hWr19r8VUlmKeT6ZXpmpjSQUHuvPPlbpZ)

_Pathway to Victory_ is committed to equipping believers with biblical teaching and reaching the unsaved by spreading the Good News of Jesus Christ through the most effective means available: radio, television, digital, and print. Your gifts fuel that important work and enable people worldwide to experience an intimate walk with Christ. Thank you for your faithful support.

May our study of Revelation prepare, strengthen, and inspire you. Come quickly, Lord Jesus.

Sharing the Truth of God's Word, ____

| | Dr. Robert Jeffress Senior Pastor, First Baptist Dallas

body:
It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

| | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=430c0b49d8d144c6942b946176b0c09a&_e=-pyCjPVDqrcgIjpmCvOoQqPXYlfxX6mOdlvcSH9Bm6cZz35i78EmWbZWVhohlWYX8YnsSVmAMYbDHmVGv2hPvyt8C2SBT-zvfSsFKz2QWvgnt5cVogcnAoDDl6Ud4ZQf1FVKi0PL6dGefIdHXegdOb4lBRLwniMXM8zFx6TSeu_B3kaJrgq-Fgn8Zgsd04tau1bsHTVhJMo6UeRw4LdJ5iSKonv7iFvcbVInnoRSyL6QLhoQTOq3GxQTgpbDeTVmRiyw-Nfn86Ijq6ZaKS13mf9FkozlReuA9q8_LgDp3QaaED8rDaelJr7ntxqpARxPcP-dmdHP852kYnXTI57tlPyq9KHhB34HArC7-6_EH3kiN14na8c4gJ5LrOk0yfuyUQnzeYBRTVS5f0wlp8VPSANd0w6gbbMgyNVLK5iEcbw6FO8uej0cApUuYSktbVYq)
---
Hello Friend,

Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings, our Savior, will return.

That's the heart of Revelation.

Each day on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale. Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is near.

This isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about revealing Jesus Christ.

When Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns, that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's Revelation's essence.

As the great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of our King.

In my brand-new book, _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ , I tackle five common questions about the end times. We'll delve into:

1\. America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the Antichrist?
2\. The Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this apocalyptic event?
3\. The Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4\. Gog and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their appearance?
5\. The Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the unsure.

In addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative. [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=430c0b49d8d144c6942b946176b0c09a&_e=-pyCjPVDqrcgIjpmCvOoQqPXYlfxX6mOdlvcSH9Bm6cZz35i78EmWbZWVhohlWYX8YnsSVmAMYbDHmVGv2hPvyt8C2SBT-zvfSsFKz2QWvgnt5cVogcnAoDDl6Ud4ZQf1FVKi0PL6dGefIdHXegdOb4lBRLwniMXM8zFx6TSeu_B3kaJrgq-Fgn8Zgsd04tau1bsHTVhJMo6UeRw4LdJ5iSKonv7iFvcbVInnoRSyL6QLhoQTOq3GxQTgpbDeTVmRiyw-Nfn86Ijq6ZaKS13mW5Er8xciCqzKH_SreimdDtpbYkt6-D_9oG6Tlt9PFySY1UuIZ_Xc4psn526QQ1ohLgGrP3zjEZ9Z7ImGdZ0mqGCDuOK7keID4W_VE7w6XVR57rEPLYaMcczVVokw44Sb2fDT2MSXr0QPy2nPxJtAljqab91Ss5mfyfOZa4N2sPI) I would like to send you my brand-new book _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ and my brand-new resource "The Major Characters of the End Times" as a thank you for your generous support of $10 or more to the ministry of _Pathway to Victory_.

Make your generous gift here: [https://secure.ptv.org/mysteries-of-the-end-times-generous-gift-1-dr-robert-jeffress](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=430c0b49d8d144c6942b946176b0c09a&_e=-pyCjPVDqrcgIjpmCvOoQqPXYlfxX6mOdlvcSH9Bm6cZz35i78EmWbZWVhohlWYX8YnsSVmAMYbDHmVGv2hPvyt8C2SBT-zvfSsFKz2QWvgnt5cVogcnAoDDl6Ud4ZQf1FVKi0PL6dGefIdHXegdOb4lBRLwniMXM8zFx6TSeu_B3kaJrgq-Fgn8Zgsd04tau1bsHTVhJMo6UeRw4LdJ5iSKonv7iFvcbVInnoRSyL6QLhoQTOq3GxQTgpbDeTVmRiyw-Nfn86Ijq6ZaKS13meFtzoljSgjtDd38jjKSoLEfgCAKJzUq5PcqBDaiq-G8HR-VOJ3fvx-eqrzhzyh2cYkAGVmXjd677aJaJqhr2W57UDK__aWe1DK8iurB5PYV44fJe-ZGZjI3vTJw3Kf-JKbC0zPLIInPEzDCz87GtDr9txzpriYUPuecJt3oIW78)

_Pathway to Victory_ is committed to equipping believers with biblical teaching and reaching the unsaved by spreading the Good News of Jesus Christ through the most effective means available: radio, television, digital, and print. Your gifts fuel that important work and enable people worldwide to experience an intimate walk with Christ. Thank you for your faithful support.

May our study of Revelation prepare, strengthen, and inspire you. Come quickly, Lord Jesus.

Sharing the Truth of God's Word, ____

| | **But do they truly understand the history and outcomes of socialism and capitalism?** This is _precisely_ why we put together this brand new eBook, **[_The History Of Socialism And Capitalism_](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=95db006a438041569f52460f444126a9&_e=8Cc6AiSeRAKNHF-vvji_TSJiPYU4FJgh0ywU4-ay6zyIsEvCAYzfxMlWx-yoxOi8AwPrEYWak3gmASLlJHdmDM9VlYwjkeipp4gKLBZyH9F_6PXYs9YhnDZXfS_kz2S32QS24VwqroJ7FTjBwQR0m6mKCHmzq1rTFW_ZQ1TOG-_YE0pix6vvHzfHaEDZ32viUX_wd-AF56KMds4qY2fV6FrQhfu4Mwf_1d4RGdlx1m2ZS9lOcPO5b63ZsggH8Eg6FYr5rccjmQmq4ok3kaCLUaXo1RGEveT2pCi7ol-FQsynw5OFdCW0Y3U_DjHB8daNE8cu1hZ6lYE6zlY2wA6QSrWbc3YDM-xWxxOoGwcIkczTnzjskqdiiJ-8v6gfOcP5ykenKJSBQBjbG5oGv186aLjj2bXDOWAavAuqZw5Lgnw%3D)**[](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=95db006a438041569f52460f444126a9&_e=8Cc6AiSeRAKNHF-vvji_TSJiPYU4FJgh0ywU4-ay6zyIsEvCAYzfxMlWx-yoxOi8AwPrEYWak3gmASLlJHdmDM9VlYwjkeipp4gKLBZyH9F_6PXYs9YhnDZXfS_kz2S32QS24VwqroJ7FTjBwQR0m6mKCHmzq1rTFW_ZQ1TOG-_YE0pix6vvHzfHaEDZ32viUX_wd-AF56KMds4qY2fV6FrQhfu4Mwf_1d4RGdlx1m2ZS9lOcPO5b63ZsggH8Eg637VF3ANAV3zATVbmwpTO4CoxTrcRRfTTygR0kxWoO7k23hf3VIiOZS8BkLI2JDiqGBG8gxZiHmaYFyWscn8WSgOwk5KMqbmsnAipuPGSfLZU6GwLALpY9582DLz6_JFfeFzfN5TYT6VTyDEEND2Am2DLwYHd9MCyw9vXG7FCZ7o%3D), from Hoover Institution senior fellows Niall Ferguson and Victor Davis Hanson. subject: Were high heels designed for men?
body:
Long before the days of stilettos and pumps, kitten heels and wedges, high-heeled shoes were worn by men. [](https://track.historyfacts.com/?xtl=1krv9cfc68a4ko6qjdjks5xue1pg5ql1v51p83pwit7m0r8je1ijq5cnx1uikoseqgjdcevffg3td3mq9z31ohd97e4p3j616j73jnohl9xluvwvzoiaujxtf3a7prasuoziuhhohedlk2evv8693dx92&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgpqlz&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

# [High heels used to be for men.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgpqlz&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Arts & Culture](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgpqlz&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgpqlz&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| L ong before the days of stilettos and pumps, kitten heels and wedges, high-heeled shoes were worn by men. As far back as the 10th century, Persian soldiers and emissaries wore heels when riding, battling, or traveling to faraway lands. These heels weren’t for show, however; they were for function. When a soldier wore heeled boots on a horse, he was able to better steady himself and generate more balance both for riding and fighting. Persian soldiers were also able to stand upright in their stirrups, positioning their feet so the space between the heel and the sole was snug in the stirrup, which gave them an advantage in battle.
---
Once heels made their way to Europe in the 16th century, their purpose was much more akin to how we think of these shoes today. Men in the French, Spanish, German, and Russian courts wore heels to project height and physical stature in order to intimidate rivals and foreign diplomats in court. Over the course of the next 200 years, men’s heels got [shorter and stockier](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgpqlz&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) — making the shoes better for balance and walking, and less of an ornate fashion statement. By the 18th century, high heels faded out of fashion for men, who started to favor less flamboyant clothing and accessories. When women started to wear high heels, the goal was to hide as much of the foot as possible beneath a long skirt. The peeking toe suggested a small foot, showing daintiness. Though sneakers are far more popular than heels today, the concept of the “platform sneaker” suggests that the ethos of the high heel is not yet a thing of the past.

## Red soles and heels date back to the 17th century.
Red-bottomed shoes are most often attributed to the contemporary fashion designer Christian Louboutin, yet footwear with red soles and heels dates all the way back to 17th-century France and England. King Charles II’s [coronation portrait](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgpqlz&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) from 1661 displays him wearing red-soled heels, known as the “French style,” which were popular in England during that time. Red was a popular color for royalty due to the pricey nature of the dye, and the color came to symbolize power and masculinity.

name: Bob MacGuffie
subject: Greenwich Republican Falling Into Democrats' Perennial Trap
body:
Breaking Commentary
| | | |
---
| Breaking Commentary
---
---
| | July 16, 2024
Last Tuesday Joe Bentivegna, heretofore a conservative writer, revealed he has fallen prey to one of the Left's favorite and most effective political traps. On July 1st I published "The Race vs. Jim Himes Cannot Be Contested on a Democrat-Defined Political Battlefield." The article diagnoses two of the most effective gambits played against Republicans, election cycle after cycle. See the complete article [Here](https://lk9rohfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001B_cO4H1B4r4Obt58ZqrdKp4apTeA5HTLJT1avy9VTmzZXv5KDWHpBMVY1FWh9XXXEZhJDuwoYzRrf35C5s9TxPEAy33vcoKyudaYvXZw3_bQtOTx-trQ2I62XIkmK7oq_RfvefTquThxQQ1tJWOk9M26iXefvGLfagPmqeFAvUG4P9mFUPRAZO9z-LeFb0YnDrfs4NstJkJjGDSThUAoZS2bWOxg3nClexBiKAhKeIHaFvWKaR1VuY_SMAnHwT5_ACcQtjH63Roqs7Ic_rpnaw==&c=SbgveArOrm6v6zygFyvrI6_EbQD13FUCRZZI2VBCya60Be6mjlbv3w==&ch=ONeHvJFd8x5m6OX_5z7EU19ys3JU-fmkPeXCpE-Sk1iLVCVtiUXvJA==). In short, the article illustrates how the Politico-Media Leftist machine, through intimidation and polarization, makes the most effective Republican figures and most effective issues 'radioactive' i.e., too hot for Republicans to touch or be associated with. The result is too many Republicans avoid our most effective issues during campaigns, and in the end sound principle-less, and more like Democrats, playing right into the hands of the Left. The other Leftist gambit deployed against us is the deception that voters registered as Unaffiliated are 'moderates', simply seeking 'reasonable-sounding solutions.' The reality is that voters who do not 'affiliate' with either party are in-fact, largely principled people. They see the Democrats as deceptive and in recent years as on the wrong track. They see Republicans as not firmly standing up and opposing the Democrat agenda, and if they do, there's little to no follow-up with action. The voting behavior of the Unaffiliateds over the last fifteen years has confirmed this insight. But Tuesday, Joe Bentivegna, circulated an [Article](https://lk9rohfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001B_cO4H1B4r4Obt58ZqrdKp4apTeA5HTLJT1avy9VTmzZXv5KDWHpBJ1tONGVa81TSO3kF_M2AuKmy4WhTuBDYimYm9UhISH5wwaVGv_LJReUtiWDQo4khTgpKGl_uDwU_2bbtQ6GMlNyYCyHy1vUqZ_XIuR2jYFbGPs94A-WokA=&c=SbgveArOrm6v6zygFyvrI6_EbQD13FUCRZZI2VBCya60Be6mjlbv3w==&ch=ONeHvJFd8x5m6OX_5z7EU19ys3JU-fmkPeXCpE-Sk1iLVCVtiUXvJA==) which stunningly falls right into the Left's favorite trap! It follows a similar prior [Article](https://lk9rohfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001B_cO4H1B4r4Obt58ZqrdKp4apTeA5HTLJT1avy9VTmzZXv5KDWHpBJ1tONGVa81T8vdRKuNs2YBdjkMV3wVZRL7xeTl-5AJ0a27vZJ5p1ybsknJC6xyuaLxUxmzLSWk_qh7LEJXf7ELL4Wb3lQXLWa41a5vdIxxgLc3VrTCInfP3WMbPdlYa7RHWLYs-3rToXwoE1XRLOGlZlHnHWFqfHxMHcnh0dCFvfvAsvyO_DfZM0FmlMrRbdYNc_1P-7Y_qOprfBHTHPLMnfjR34iZhRzdfXcYFK0Wh&c=SbgveArOrm6v6zygFyvrI6_EbQD13FUCRZZI2VBCya60Be6mjlbv3w==&ch=ONeHvJFd8x5m6OX_5z7EU19ys3JU-fmkPeXCpE-Sk1iLVCVtiUXvJA==). Joe, over the last decade had several times encouraged me to make a run against Jim Himes. But today, he's a surrogate and writes on behalf of his personal friend, my opponent in the 4th District congressional primary. In the articles, Bentivegna advises us that my opponent is a "moderate" and will have a moderate "coattail effect" for the rest of the ticket. Yes, he is advising the same failed strategy that has brought us seven straight double-digit losses against Mr. Himes since 2010... and about 41 of all the 45 Federal seat losses in CT since 2006! It is a fool's errand to run this playbook yet again. This 'pursuing the moderates' gameplan leads to the Republican candidate shape-shifting his position when challenged, and sounding increasingly like the incumbent Democrat's positioning in an effort to attract his voters. But why should they switch when they think they already have a 'moderate' (albeit a fraudulent one in the person of Jim Himes) in office. The result is that principled Republicans become discouraged and depress turnout, and the majority of Unaffiliateds see no reason to vote for the Republican. This 'aping' of the Democrat positioning to any degree, is a proven losing strategy in Connecticut. The only way to drive turnout for the entire ticket is to energize Republicans from the top down by taking principled stands on our issues, and responding with more 'offense' when challenged. We need a full-throated articulation of our nation's founding principles, and advancement of our Republican issues, because these issues resonate in both our towns and our cities. Nothing less than our American way-of-life is at stake. Mr. Obama's "fundamental transformation of America" is in full-bloom today, in every corner of our society. And, more and more of our neighbors are waking up to this reality every day. Unfortunately, there can be no 'consensus-building', as my opponent has put it, with a party that seeks our elimination and a permanent majority for themselves. We need to fight for the African-American and Hispanic voters that Himes takes for granted in Bridgeport; we need to fight for the Jewish voters that Himes insults with his pro-C.A.I.R. comments in Norwalk; and we need to fight for the young professionals seeking in vain for affordable housing for their growing families in Stamford. I am only in this race to fight for the cherished principles of our American way of life for all the citizens of the 4th District - and to champion them right through to an upset victory over Jim Himes on November 5th. I am the candidate to handle a hostile press (and it will get mighty hostile when the race tightens), because I've already been through it all. I will upend all the deceptive Leftist gambits deployed against us by Mr. Himes and the DNC - and finally return true representation to all the solid citizens of the 4th District. They deserve nothing less. In order to accomplish it, I need your support and would be honored with your vote in the August 13th Primary. | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE TUESDAY, JULY 16 ICYMI: KELLY LOEFFLER PENS OP-ED CELEBRATING TRUMP'S STRENGTH, VISION FOR AMERICA ATLANTA - In advance of the Republican National Convention, former U.S. Senator Kelly Loeffler (R-GA) published a [new op-ed](https://8mpsjjfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001oBGESl68Zr6UeXqGOWm9ssG52e0fIr2Q-_AWuNfCMREaybxV56eJgPvqLS_I58SrJa1wAWpEdC1hCDREl4FtS2Q0bDUpvb2ElapZKGBKjmZ2l5379tJXFvFVBmLz9S1jM1byWnEIvA4g8yFX3q5NGoVHpCZj0bHlltFgHq16MNcuMsV6ujytIcfToYCx_0I9ab59iuexhEsWcljpwojU-pleC9FNa9FtxoUPOxEqrvCLqtIsiI24nETQcrwJhfiUrH4KNHihTmPyvlzpItBxAoyYYVNL4iDyPQb8dDLXvxU=&c=YECCVbg9UJNezV7--Bq1M7aUcdSZdfr6SHrVFtr-tXxkFl-CXeQynw==&ch=L_qkNFnULZqZaQjFdFUq6iugVYIR4Hyw2tMaU9QGJMm_Z3IZK7MFjA==) in the Atlanta Journal-Constitution celebrating the extraordinary strength of President Donald Trump in the face of this weekend's assassination attempt. She urged the country to move past the tactics of political targeting and divisive rhetoric to unite behind Trump's uplifting vision to restore our nation. Read the full op-ed [here](https://8mpsjjfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001oBGESl68Zr6UeXqGOWm9ssG52e0fIr2Q-_AWuNfCMREaybxV56eJgPvqLS_I58SrJa1wAWpEdC1hCDREl4FtS2Q0bDUpvb2ElapZKGBKjmZ2l5379tJXFvFVBmLz9S1jM1byWnEIvA4g8yFX3q5NGoVHpCZj0bHlltFgHq16MNcuMsV6ujytIcfToYCx_0I9ab59iuexhEsWcljpwojU-pleC9FNa9FtxoUPOxEqrvCLqtIsiI24nETQcrwJhfiUrH4KNHihTmPyvlzpItBxAoyYYVNL4iDyPQb8dDLXvxU=&c=YECCVbg9UJNezV7--Bq1M7aUcdSZdfr6SHrVFtr-tXxkFl-CXeQynw==&ch=L_qkNFnULZqZaQjFdFUq6iugVYIR4Hyw2tMaU9QGJMm_Z3IZK7MFjA==) or see excerpts below:
Loeffler: The attempt on Trump's life clarified the stakes of this election The former president has long refused to surrender to the forces that would see him fail.
Spared by God's grace, bloodied and back on his feet moments after getting shot -- with his fist punching defiantly toward heaven -- Trump said to America: "Fight." And, with his quintessential drive, he kept moving.
The audience erupted into chants of "USA, USA, USA." The next day, the iconic photos appeared on the cover of every newspaper. It replaced Trump's mug shot as the most consequential symbol of political persecution.
...
For years, the left has waged a war on Trump under the guise of saving "democracy." Rather than running on a positive vision for the future, they exhort voters to view Trump as an existential threat to justify their relentless attacks. Whether trying to defame, bankrupt, imprison or villainize him, the goal was to protect their power -- and to destroy him.
...
Last week, [Biden told donors](https://8mpsjjfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001oBGESl68Zr6UeXqGOWm9ssG52e0fIr2Q-_AWuNfCMREaybxV56eJgPvqLS_I58SrvLa17eNGRu4vtPXk2trwusVNj9ad_uSN_GccEjQqsv_c-OTG7Uj8r94Y5Gmmo3XAxuRhKTFdH0jWL1XwWkLKefAd7MZTC41Fgs28EuW13YRI_B8zJw-vl28wcgrnzN3wdSVeJ0zoNnePC06TYNAOwuYTIukZ3580HU_Cso0sVp90CEx5i7Wi1dB0-thugP24LwwZXSMCAwUaC7--3U94qJwKGb-cBDgN&c=YECCVbg9UJNezV7--Bq1M7aUcdSZdfr6SHrVFtr-tXxkFl-CXeQynw==&ch=L_qkNFnULZqZaQjFdFUq6iugVYIR4Hyw2tMaU9QGJMm_Z3IZK7MFjA==) it was "time to put Trump in the bull's-eye," and [Vice President Kamala Harris warned supporters](https://8mpsjjfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001oBGESl68Zr6UeXqGOWm9ssG52e0fIr2Q-_AWuNfCMREaybxV56eJgPvqLS_I58Sr2zHAKnidVqfd57uOjd2Oi1aKu7tFpkCMuandhTAZ5oEwS-cICVbzi91f_mSaPejvamy4keoScGEKGbeeU3TQKa8cbYyTfoZ9hgtup9J9dgqJqRE8Y-7uViYx83qVlLdNNctDIdVkBwO-5viOHGEl1BMDcThk_AtCOLPUPal4n9S-FMldDBFVl1DPPKtiifWju0NpD7rWxc2QCcaulZf9_pCn_rgbgQHYZWI3DvGLTbc=&c=YECCVbg9UJNezV7--Bq1M7aUcdSZdfr6SHrVFtr-tXxkFl-CXeQynw==&ch=L_qkNFnULZqZaQjFdFUq6iugVYIR4Hyw2tMaU9QGJMm_Z3IZK7MFjA==) that "Trump wants to turn our democracy into a dictatorship." Still today, Biden's campaign website calls Trump a "[dangerous threat](https://8mpsjjfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001oBGESl68Zr6UeXqGOWm9ssG52e0fIr2Q-_AWuNfCMREaybxV56eJgPvqLS_I58SrIA27w9DbesletLpGutBkKuU3y4ZvUex7Ls4uMWpZ78011HrjoitQ5Ol49IxtdTk67o2yHrn1bO1j1Ji8Zcv6ehUOnQ4e2Y9g&c=YECCVbg9UJNezV7--Bq1M7aUcdSZdfr6SHrVFtr-tXxkFl-CXeQynw==&ch=L_qkNFnULZqZaQjFdFUq6iugVYIR4Hyw2tMaU9QGJMm_Z3IZK7MFjA==)," and the Democratic National Committee is [running an ad in Georgia](https://8mpsjjfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001oBGESl68Zr6UeXqGOWm9ssG52e0fIr2Q-_AWuNfCMREaybxV56eJgPvqLS_I58SrZYvP-XEdu6OB3Z1xQ9J0jrITAwFPk-m8hmLL2hYZiuQ1X4bTBKryS4bUhG9rQvVtPDOHSQ8mwl393WNEvn_OsXJEPXSVJf9XDO8GZbPmWlLpb1WdmMklC9FoDXDF5AcMd3Un-L8Vzt9b4-kX_YFwZ2bjeFfP7xDWOrFPGB52-heU9XQdFs5QwH3TfF9AL7yDn86MxQjytn10RX8rNxOY4iKIoGk-0h0VRv5-CRMddlU=&c=YECCVbg9UJNezV7--Bq1M7aUcdSZdfr6SHrVFtr-tXxkFl-CXeQynw==&ch=L_qkNFnULZqZaQjFdFUq6iugVYIR4Hyw2tMaU9QGJMm_Z3IZK7MFjA==) claiming Trump is the "ultimate threat to democracy.

These are not isolated or unusual statements. They are some of the more restrained [attacks against Trump](https://8mpsjjfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001oBGESl68Zr6UeXqGOWm9ssG52e0fIr2Q-_AWuNfCMREaybxV56eJgPvqLS_I58SrficQoEOYjok_8JTjckXf3rBMaZrzJmv0W9SLgudYcl3m2bsykQk7qjuuPCfW1XcqMvRovRsp-VeKI_3jGh7aTaph6CckRNmdR6OZ14sxKvEnLOIDnC3TAAynl4yjQ-Rxa0lHKa7G4vhlUDUXNmni98tNjC2zIwAjcIHlCHUFnM1Yo17udeKrVA==&c=YECCVbg9UJNezV7--Bq1M7aUcdSZdfr6SHrVFtr-tXxkFl-CXeQynw==&ch=L_qkNFnULZqZaQjFdFUq6iugVYIR4Hyw2tMaU9QGJMm_Z3IZK7MFjA==). The media, quick to blame Trump for Jan. 6, 2021, has also fanned the flames of violence by ignoring or, worse, amplifying the anti-Trump rhetoric and tropes.
...
Trump and his family have withstood baseless, extralegal lawfare, egregious personal attacks and now an assassination attempt with courage, optimism and extraordinary determination. It is a testament to his love for our country that he remains committed to restoring it no matter the cost.
But, in America, the price should never be this high.
Even amid the great loss of this unprecedented attack, Trump still sees only the best in this nation. His belief that we can chart a path forward to a better America is backed up by a [simple, one-page plan](https://8mpsjjfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001oBGESl68Zr6UeXqGOWm9ssG52e0fIr2Q-_AWuNfCMREaybxV56eJgPvqLS_I58Sr-6Uep_XCxtpUKNGNc48qMIi90wvjT9eNSOJCAa8AU4HVFOO2y4m07uBKr3d6zK_r6BkoUeMzC5cnF-6y91-xs7syynXZnOnHmAF65SIlxfD9ESpOocKXnlO_k0jUtkCFZNoxO0lDA39GIFM_MQmiXyST23crGYMURSrIM_j46gBLsauNwEGqUnDgjvreikcy&c=YECCVbg9UJNezV7--Bq1M7aUcdSZdfr6SHrVFtr-tXxkFl-CXeQynw==&ch=L_qkNFnULZqZaQjFdFUq6iugVYIR4Hyw2tMaU9QGJMm_Z3IZK7MFjA==), free from divisive rhetoric and blame-game victimization. I encourage everyone to read both candidates' policy pages on their respective websites. The contrast is stark.
We might not all be Republicans, even after these tragic events. But we are all blessed to be Americans who can decide to unite in the pursuit of a more perfect union. Now is the time to work together for healing and the restoration of the United States of America.

## Trump Wins Nomination, Taps Vance as VP
Former President Trump won the formal nomination for president from cheering delegates at the GOP national convention Monday. Earlier in the day, he [announced Ohio Senator JD Vance](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx80DFvgzAQBeBfAxuR73zYMHjoki1dO6LDHIkrYyPHIeq_r-gP6PKkT295el-36cYhhnT_5E1cXfPEvoZDpniG7cB0SBO1i1tFUHQrDiwCEGnq24dDb40RQpxR9TwAjgTe9iMoO4JddBscKiRlwQCi0sOFtPbr6pceeQVrdENKllBzuXznkOpD1viTDykXn7c2uket-7PRHw1eG7zynuT9PKsTpQYfpcFrLa9t74rsrzkGz6lLXENOHDuf0yHpRNcPXo2iRzPb0fbgiWaWBYhhJo08tMUt-zvEGJ7GNqTuG4f4t6L-c8zh8DcAAP__eCRmJA) as his running mate. The 39-year-old [Vance is a Yale-educated](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kDFuxCAURE-DOyz4gLELijR0mzalRfBnzQaDZViv9vaRc4A004xm9PS-bvPNxRTz_dNtaFoos_MtnjinKzTlAwU5y24xARFQdGi4Bs6lFFJ1q5Fj0EEtoxumb6XUNPlJMjUFNnpUXokuGmAgmeYDB2Bi7KUQPgS_KHCB60EQyXCJrRz9o8TcVgzpXU48el-2Lpm1tb0S8UHAErD5vZfaroqAvY4JWKYJWK4I2GelGV-VgG3Hc9tpdhtWWtZYaMVMHws9XfZI11jpNabnTvfofwjY7jDL_oopxTpoItl9czH9IbR_rJwGfgMAAP__9H9kMA) venture capitalist and a first-term senator. Before entering politics, Vance authored _Hillbilly Elegy_ , a bestselling memoir that was later adapted into a film. Vance was [an outspoken critic of Trump](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8j7FugzAURb_G3oLs5wcOg4cubOnaERnznLzK4BQsnPx9RT-gy9WVjnSk83Ubb54Tr_dPv5ArMY8-FD5oTOfYi-4ugCPK2UUiICPJaQtaIxps5cNBwNboqMn3bTsZFWCmHqO-TmB7JCvZgQJUVncaQJlrg8aEGMPcgo_adkagoplL3prvzGt5UEzvfNDWhLzI5B6lPHdhPgQMAoZaazNN4WQChpXqLmDwW-GQ6Lzh1ffwA-v7pbLc3PysnBLvnRWo7ovn9Gct_4QeDn4DAAD__y9uVvc) in the run-up to the 2020 election but has since become an ardent supporter of the former president. Trump endorsed Vance during the 2022 Senate midterm elections. Trump cited Vance's military service, business success, and moral values as factors [in his decision](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kDGO6yAURVeDu2fBg-CkoPiNu_x2SouBR0yEwcLYVnY_8ixgmlPc2xydr-f0tDHF_PpvFzItlMm6Fg-a0oUBhAZUk-q8CURIsiMjBhRCKalu3WzswwVO6oGSfw863ANqzoPi4e6k1qi7aJCj4oPQApHLe6-kdCE4f0MbxKAlU5x8bKX27xJzmymkTzmo9q4sXTJza-vG5D-GI8PxPM--0t6obtd_LaUmz3DcN4bj28NhsyMoF1xZVlvJQ6v7ssIcW6IKuZzQZvqArQR1zznmFyy20QaXKfABxI3h2FXj1zOmFDc9MMVfi43pV6r90ekw-BMAAP__02Js7w). _" After lengthy deliberation and thought, and considering the tremendous talents of many others, I have decided that the person best suited to assume the position of Vice President of the United States is Senator JD Vance,"_ Trump said.
## Judge Dismisses Trump Documents Case
A federal judge in Florida [dismissed the classified documents case](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kDGO8yAUhE-DOyx4YMhfUPyNu2y7pUXgEb8IG8vgWLn9ynuAbaYZzcyn-b5Pd0-Z1ueXX9C1VCYfGr1xypdYLg0HPekuuoQIqDp00oKUWis9dLNL0RpjEG-3h9JWKy2SHP4ZC8IPHkF35ECAFlYaCSDUrddKhZRCHMAnaY1iWmCkVvb-VWhtM6b8KW_c-1CWLru5ta0y9Z_ByGA8z7MP6yNcJoPxqmYwCstglAODse3HsvGQfa2UCCOPJRwLrq3y4CvySHWhWjHyx4e_jvhEfm3xumEgn3kox1oxc79tF8yV7Oe25G53cTspZ6rGMi2ei6f8S9j-OO3t4CcAAP__5BZyYw) against former President Trump on Monday, ruling that the special counsel prosecuting the case was illegally appointed by the Justice Department. Attorney General Merrick Garland appointed [Jack Smith as special counsel](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx80LGO4yAUheGnwR2WuRDABcU27rLtlhaBS3IjDJYhsfbtR5nppznN1xz9_67r1VOmcv_rN3Q91dWHTm9c82cMF5qDWtUQXUIElAM6YUAIpaS6DA8Hsw1wsTrpWXsfFd5AGOnnWc7WTsEM5GACNRmhBcAk7aikDCmFeAGfhNGSqQkj9XqMz0qlPzDl__WNxxjqNmT36H1vTP5hsDBYzvMcyy0UPNvHGSx7zdQpNAZLrMXnyPvx2nYGS8r1oOj58xXvyCO1jVrD9uM8ZN8aJcLIYw2vDUtvPPiG_AjFCy2sscPh4n5SztS0YWq6b57y96_-S6q3g68AAAD__8CScCE) in 2022 to oversee federal investigations into Trump's handling of classified documents at his Mar-a-Lago residence in Palm Beach after he left office. Judge Cannon found the appointment unconstitutional, citing the Appointments Clause, which requires "Officers of the United States" to be appointed by the president and confirmed by the Senate. Trump applauded the ruling and demanded that his three other criminal cases also be thrown out. Democrats urged an immediate appeal.
## Mona Lisa's Grand Estate For Sale
The 16th-century grand estate of the real Mona Lisa's family is up for sale, listed at nearly $20 million and boasting 14 bedrooms and 15 bathrooms on 67 acres outside Florence, Italy. [Pictures are here.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8jzFuxCAQAF8DHSdYOLiGIo27S5vSwng5b7QYy0aO_Pvo8oA000wxmq_n-EzEtL4-U8XYSxtT7nTiyG8EZbwCNzo5x4IIaCVGE8AY56y7yyV6j8XkyU8ep5StNdoF73S5Q4Ew6SApggang_EGQNvHzVmbS8nzHVIxwVvhNM7U2377brT2BQtf7cT9lluVHJfet0PYDwGDgGHDtjG-lYChtjUppiOpkirxpZZWUZW2qyMxKloV9cSXevgQPBi5x3n7IWY6fBBOv2oi_qv0f8bPCL8BAAD__x9LXLg) At one time, the 30,000-square-foot estate belonged to the family of Francesco del Giocondo, husband of [Lisa del Giocondo,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8jzFuhDAQAF9jdyB7bWyucJGG7tKmRHt4DRsZfAILdHl9dHlAmqlGI83XfbwjZ97mT1wp1FRGnCqfNOY3fKNdA3a0MoZEBGQkBe1Ba2uN7eQSoqJHp24Ju1tE1zuvJ9U_UgTlo4feSw6gwCqvnQZQpm-tMVNKU-wAk_bOCKsoci17-114qwul_Con7e1UVpnDUuvzEOZDwCBguK6rjcj5hXtdccYf3ugtChjWsmGT-UABg9xDfF6cMx_OC6vmFTn_Bes_j2eA3wAAAP___XpWXA) whom many scholars believe was the model for Leonardo da Vinci's famous painting. The estate features a main villa and [numerous additional structures,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kDFywyAQRU8jdauBBYuooEijzmlTajAs1iZIaAA7o9tnnAOk-c1_xZv3eV2ujhPv9w-3kW0xL843ftKSXmNAjoB60X2wkQhJ9WSlQSm1VvrSr1ZcxDQ5aaZRhKB9GKcxkCclvImk_a1niwK1MHKUiEK9DVopH6MPF3RRmlF1WlDglsvwlXlvK8V05ieVweetT3Zt7aideu9w7nBuhW-PnV7fcHx3ONeWy9nhjNpMyogXshIUcgm2vDtIXF2F6DZOJ1BtrhHwDjHlQrsn4ObSCVzhcUDMBapL1Bcbjh9OietoOi3um-P0p9P-KfS0-BsAAP__nkxsFQ) including a caretaker's house, buildings for agricultural use, a private chapel, a swimming pool, and a tennis court. It includes gardens, tree-lined avenues, and a large forest.

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 7/15/2024
body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi folks!
I hope this message finds you well and inspired! I'm writing to share the exhilarating energy from the first day of the Republican National Convention. It's been an incredible experience meeting countless like-minded freedom fighters from across our great nation, all united in our dedication to uphold and celebrate our cherished values. The spirit of liberty is truly alive here, palpable in every conversation and echoing through the corridors with enthusiastic discussions about our future.
Adding to the excitement, the announcement of J.D. Vance as President Trump's vice presidential pick has sent waves of positive chatter throughout the crowd. His vision aligns seamlessly with the fervent patriotism and vibrant energy of the convention. It's thrilling to be a part of this historic moment, surrounded by individuals who are deeply committed to preserving and advancing the cause of freedom in our Republic.
This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, July 16, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl, from the Republican National Convention in Milwaukee
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Ohio Sen J.D. Vance will join Trump on Republican ticket as VP](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_With an eye toward the future of a Republican Party dominated by former President Trump and his legions of MAGA supporters, Trump has named 39-year-old Sen. J.D. Vance of Ohio as his running mate on the GOP’S 2024 national ticket._
_The former president, who made his greatly anticipated and high-stakes announcement on Monday as the Republican National Convention kicked off in swing-state Wisconsin’s largest city, will now share the ticket with one of his top supporters in the Senate and a one-time Trump critic who has transformed into a leading America First disciple._
_Vance, a former venture capitalist and the author of the bestselling memoir, “Hillbilly Elegy,” before running for elective office, was one of a handful of Republicans considered top running mate contenders. That group included North Dakota Gov. Doug Burgum and Sens. Marco Rubio of Florida and Tim Scott of South Carolina._

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**MANDY CONNELL ON THE STREET AT THE RNC**
**[07-15-24 FULL SHOW - We are off to the RNC](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)[]()** [THE MANDY CONNELL PODCAST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
**[LISTEN HERE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**RNC COVERAGE**
**[Officially, Donald Trump secures Republican Party’s Presidential nomination](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)[]()** [THE EPOCH TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Former President Donald Trump has been officially nominated as the Republican Party's 2024 presidential candidate, alongside his vice-presidential pick, Senator J.D. Vance.
* The nomination took place at the GOP convention in Milwaukee, amidst a backdrop of recent violence, including an assassination attempt on Trump that resulted in minor injuries to him and more severe consequences for others involved.
* The event highlighted Trump's resilience and ongoing legal battles, as well as the sharp policy differences between him and President Joe Biden, with significant focus on the economy, immigration, and constitutional rights.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**STATE**
**[Fabbricatore: A law enforcement leader’s perspective on the assassination attempt on President Trump](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), COMMENTARY
_Have you ever experienced a situation where things happen that are done right, but still go horribly wrong? The recent assassination attempt on President Donald Trump’s life is a stark example of this._
_While the Secret Service was prepared to lay down their lives for the former President and current Republican Presidential candidate, the fact that a shooter managed to get within 140 yards of the stage represents a significant failure in security protocols._
_Something went wrong, and, as a result, hearings should be held, Freedom of Information Act requests made, and hopefully we can come to an understanding of why this security lapse occurred._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[Griswold calls for recount in House District 58 Republican primary race decided by three votes](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)[]()** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Colorado House District 58 Republican primary race was extremely close, with just three votes separating Larry Don Suckla and Mark Roeber, triggering a mandatory recount as per state guidelines.
* The recount, required because the vote difference was within the 0.5% margin stipulated by state law, must be completed by July 26, as directed by Secretary of State Jena Griswold.
* The outcome of this recount will determine the Republican nominee who will compete against Democrat Kathleen Curry in the general election.

# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1655%2E135344%2EAdbaAT)

Friend --
Let's take a moment to talk about these FEC fundraising deadlines and the emails that clog your inbox about them.
First, our FEC deadline tomorrow is actually is a real deadline. It is a pre-primary deadline and the last one before the general election starts in Michigan. When it ends, we're legally required to report not just how much money we've raised, but how much of it comes from large donations vs. smaller donations.
Those reports are also made public and I can tell you from experience that a lot of people are looking at them. The press looks, our opponents look, potential outside spending operations look...
They want to see the strength of our campaign financially. They want to see if we have small-dollar grassroots support that is sustainable in a way large donations are not. And critically, some of the big-money super PACs want to see if we're vulnerable to an attack we can't afford to respond to.
So these very real deadlines are important -- especially this one. They are not like the fake deadlines that you see from a lot of other campaigns (never ours). And it's why every donation made in response to emails like this one matters. That's why we ask so much.
[**Can I count on you to contribute $3 (or more if you can) before our pre-primary FEC deadline comes to a close tomorrow? Believe me, I would not be asking if it were not so important.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-june24.nyVfY7&refcode=em240630-3&t=2&akid=1655%2E135344%2EAdbaAT)**

clean_body: Friend -- Let's take a moment to talk about these FEC fundraising deadlines and the emails that clog your inbox about them. First, our FEC deadline tomorrow is actually is a real deadline. It is a pre-primary deadline and the last one before the general election starts in Michigan. When it ends, we're legally required to report not just how much money we've raised, but how much of it comes from large donations vs. smaller donations. Those reports are also made public and I can tell you from experience that a lot of people are looking at them. The press looks, our opponents look, potential outside spending operations look... They want to see the strength of our campaign financially. They want to see if we have small-dollar grassroots support that is sustainable in a way large donations are not. And critically, some of the big-money super PACs want to see if we're vulnerable to an attack we can't afford to respond to. So these very real deadlines are important -- especially this one. They are not like the fake deadlines that you see from a lot of other campaigns (never ours). And it's why every donation made in response to emails like this one matters. That's why we ask so much. If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly: | | | | | | | | | ** Thank you in advance for contributing before this deadline. It means a lot to me personally. Elissa PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN P.O. Box 4145 East Lansing, MI 48826

name: Tony Evers
subject: We cannot be a country that accepts political violence
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tony for Wisconsin
body:
Derek,

My condolences go out to President Trump and
all of the families affected by the recent shooting at the political rally
in Pennsylvania over the weekend. I extend my gratitude to the first
responders and Secret Service who acted quickly, putting themselves and
their safety at risk in order to respond to a horrific act of violence and
keep people safe.

We must take a firm and united stance against political violence in all
its forms.

Now, more than ever, is the time for leaders across all political parties
to bridge our deep and dangerous divisions. Political violence strikes at
the core of our democratic system and undermines the fundamental
conditions necessary for our democracy to function properly.

[ https://go.tonyevers.com/go/2261?t=1001&akid=6800%2E1827488%2En_ZGLI ]Add your name here to join me in denouncing political violence of all
kinds. We must come together to strengthen our democracy.

We cannot be a country that accepts political violence of any kind — that
is not who we are as Americans.

Thank you,

Tony Evers

Paid for by Tony for Wisconsin

# As Gaza's death toll rises, unprecedented denial and disinformation surge.
_Attacks on the credibility of researchers and the suppression of accurate data continue to obstruct the true scale of tragedy that Palestinians are facing._
By Rebekah Jones
--
Direct casualties in Gaza have nearly reached 40,000 people since last October, with at least 10,000 Palestinians still reported missing and presumed dead.
A recent article in the the Lancet journal estimated that total casualties in Gaza may already be as high as 186,000 people, once the scale of the conflict and indirect deaths are considered. The authors used standard applications of statistics based on studies of conflict zones to provide the most broad (and conservative) estimates of the true death toll.
That article has been met with a chorus of condemnation by those with no background in geography, statistics, disaster science or public health.
Propaganda outlets have preposterously called the research "Blood Libel," invoking accusations of vampirism against Jews from the Middle Ages to label the world's most prestigious medical journal "anti-Semitic," even though one of the lead authors sits on the board of the Israel National Institute For Health Policy Research.
Reports of deaths in Gaza have been subject to meritless attack since Israel began its bombardment last year.
Those attacks have come from the highest level of authority in the United States - including United States President Joe Biden.
Conflict zones often yield large ranges of estimated deaths because of the complications inherent to war, which has been weaponised to further obfuscate the cost of lives.
Bodies trapped under the rubble in Gaza will continue to deteriorate, becoming unrecognisable with time. Thousands will be found in pieces, if any pieces are found at all.
Bodies crushed under the weight of collapsed buildings leave little behind to identify - a fact Americans already know well from our own past tragedies.
Nearly 3,000 people died in the September 11, 2001 terrorist attacks based on reports of who were in the buildings, who never arrived home, and the expected occupancy of the Twin Towers on that fateful day.
Even though the estimate of 3,000 is largely uncontested, only 1,649 have been identified via advanced DNA testing of bone fragments. And that's with the world's leading DNA technology and billions of dollars in federal funding.
The indirect death toll may be even higher. Estimates from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention's World Trade Center Health Program and the Victims Compensation Fund show nearly 4,000 claims have been filed for 9/11-related deaths, including people with cancer and airway disorders.
Gaza officials haven't even begun to catalogue or count the real toll of Israel's aggression. How can they when the area is still subject to attack and most of its key infrastructure has been destroyed?
History teaches us that denialism, especially of mass casualty events, serves to absolve responsible parties from guilt or spare them from embarrassment.
For example, Soviet officials have only recognised 31 of the estimated 4,000 to 60,000 people killed in the 1986 nuclear disaster at the Chernobyl power plant in modern-day Ukraine, and have sought to deny an accident had even occurred until radiation was detected in neighbouring countries.
American conservative media pundits and politicians flatly denied research showing that deaths attributable to Hurricane Maria (2017) reached 3,000 to 4,600 people, far more than the Trump administration figure of 64.
But deaths from hurricanes, nuclear accidents, conflict and other natural and man-made disasters have never been met with the kinds of outright contempt we're seeing now, as researchers investigating death in Gaza.
Scientists have been utilising the full breadth of data and technology available today, giving researchers more to work with in estimating total deaths from a range of mass-casualty events.
That starts with bodies in morgues, which comprises nearly all of the dead being counted in Gaza today, as well as anyone confirmed dead by the medical establishment.
Those counts also typically include excess deaths - a measure of deaths above what we expect based on the year-to-year averages over the past decade or longer.
Deaths from starvation, infection, disease, exposure, inadequate healthcare, and in some cases trauma-related injury and suicide are valid deaths to include when directly influenced by the conflict.
That still doesn't include the years of life lost from malnutrition and disability, or increased susceptibility of disease and disability from epigenetic inheritance that will plague generations to come.
Yet, until the Lancet article, those numbers were not part of the public discourse. And now that they've entered the discussion, social media is ablaze with armies of paid disinformation agents setting fire to the entire field of research.
On the internet, everyone's an expert, regardless of their education, experience or actual expertise. Political pundits comment incessantly on everything from subtropical diseases to tropical storms with the confidence of seasoned professionals, though they often lack even a fundamental understanding of the science.
Attacks on public health researchers and geographers predate the pandemic, but rarely have swallowed the whole American political apparatus and the general public in the way we've observed with Palestinian deaths in Gaza during the last nine months.
If Israeli researchers can't start the conversation in the world's most revered medical journal, where can they?
If an internationally-celebrated whistleblower and award-winning scientist who sacrificed her career, freedom and safety to report accurate death totals during the COVID-19 pandemic can't share death figures from Gaza without an onslaught of disingenuous political attacks, who can?
If we're not allowed to discuss the full extent of an ongoing genocide while it's still happening, when can we? After it's too late? Never?
When science bends to political pressure, when hordes of inauthentic social media accounts can shutter research, we are all more ignorant, helpless and blind to the reality of the world we live in.
--
_Rebekah Jones is a scientist and geographer formerly with the Florida Department of Health, where she managed health data for the state during mass casualty events, including COVID-19. Jones' work independently tracking COVID-19 earned her the title of Forbes' first-ever Technology Person of the Year, Fortune's 40 under 40 in Healthcare, and a nomination for Nature's John Maddox Prize._
