name: Andy Kim
subject: One Country, One Destiny
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Andy Kim for New Jersey
body:
Revisiting an American mantra, as another violent act grips the nation
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88960663/485717372/41798106?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NjQ3NDNhYS03OTQzLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Meznz02ZaQItY_iyDgF5CTeLyLv-U4UpUOzRKNtn7b4=&emci=2188bece-b142-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=564743aa-7943-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=26261389)
---

| | When President Lincoln was shot, he wore a coat embroidered with the phrase, "One Country, One Destiny." I've turned to those four words to help me process this moment. This assassination attempt on former President Trump was one of the worst events I've seen in our democracy. It feels like we are a country unmoored, but it does not have to be this way. These are confusing, unpredictable times, when moments like these will shape the generation to come. So what does this particular moment mean? How can we make sense of it? I reflect on a passage from Hannah Arendt, the seminal political thinker who escaped Nazi Germany, who wrote, "Power and violence are opposites; where the one rules absolutely, the other is absent." The deep unease we carry is, in part, the fact that we witnessed one person trying to use the means of violence to impose their will upon a nation of 330 million, and subvert the power of people that underlies our very democracy. The resulting trepidation reminds us that "the practice of violence, like all action, changes the world, but the most probable change is to a more violent world," as Arendt reminds us. We fear retaliation, reprisal, or escalation because of a sense that things cannot get better. In the aftermath of other recent shocks to our country, we failed to unify, and instead sadly grew more divided. I had hoped that these shocks would be what I called defibrillator moments that would shock our irregular heartbeats into normal rhythm, but we fell short. It's not just that our divisions have grown so wide in our country, but our willingness to perpetuate a mutual contempt. It's not just a disrespect that we see towards one another, it's a deeper disregard and a disgust of one another. **We are losing touch with the understanding that we are part of something bigger than all of us. And as those four words of Lincoln - One County One Destiny - remind us, the commonality we share runs deep and should not be forgotten.** Violence is cowardice, not strength. It is fiercely undemocratic. As we process this shock, we can choose to realize that we've gone too far as a society down the path of contempt. We are not each other's enemy. We are not at war. One Country, One Destiny doesn't mean we all agree, but instead reminds us that we share the same fate. Choosing to unite instead of incite does not mean we dismiss the magnitude of our differences. But it compels us to be cautious and precise about our next steps, our words, and our actions in this unbelievably precarious moment. **It reminds us that unity does not exist without hope, and that apathy and despair only further create a void in which only violence and hate fill.** We collectively mourn the death of Corey Comperatore, and we are relieved that Trump wasn't seriously injured. These may be anxious, unpredictable, and even violent times, but they can still be shaped by our actions. Now is the time to unite around Lincoln's vision of One Country, One Destiny to condemn this violence and start the long but necessary process of anchoring our nation in these turbulent times. In unity, _Andy_ |

clean_body: Revisiting an American mantra, as another violent act grips the nation | | | | When President Lincoln was shot, he wore a coat embroidered with the phrase, "One Country, One Destiny." I've turned to those four words to help me process this moment. This assassination attempt on former President Trump was one of the worst events I've seen in our democracy. It feels like we are a country unmoored, but it does not have to be this way. These are confusing, unpredictable times, when moments like these will shape the generation to come. So what does this particular moment mean? How can we make sense of it? I reflect on a passage from Hannah Arendt, the seminal political thinker who escaped Nazi Germany, who wrote, "Power and violence are opposites; where the one rules absolutely, the other is absent." The deep unease we carry is, in part, the fact that we witnessed one person trying to use the means of violence to impose their will upon a nation of 330 million, and subvert the power of people that underlies our very democracy. The resulting trepidation reminds us that "the practice of violence, like all action, changes the world, but the most probable change is to a more violent world," as Arendt reminds us. We fear retaliation, reprisal, or escalation because of a sense that things cannot get better. In the aftermath of other recent shocks to our country, we failed to unify, and instead sadly grew more divided. I had hoped that these shocks would be what I called defibrillator moments that would shock our irregular heartbeats into normal rhythm, but we fell short. It's not just that our divisions have grown so wide in our country, but our willingness to perpetuate a mutual contempt. It's not just a disrespect that we see towards one another, it's a deeper disregard and a disgust of one another. We are losing touch with the understanding that we are part of something bigger than all of us. And as those four words of Lincoln - One County One Destiny - remind us, the commonality we share runs deep and should not be forgotten. Violence is cowardice, not strength. It is fiercely undemocratic. As we process this shock, we can choose to realize that we've gone too far as a society down the path of contempt. We are not each other's enemy. We are not at war. One Country, One Destiny doesn't mean we all agree, but instead reminds us that we share the same fate. Choosing to unite instead of incite does not mean we dismiss the magnitude of our differences. But it compels us to be cautious and precise about our next steps, our words, and our actions in this unbelievably precarious moment. It reminds us that unity does not exist without hope, and that apathy and despair only further create a void in which only violence and hate fill. We collectively mourn the death of Corey Comperatore, and we are relieved that Trump wasn't seriously injured. These may be anxious, unpredictable, and even violent times, but they can still be shaped by our actions. Now is the time to unite around Lincoln's vision of One Country, One Destiny to condemn this violence and start the long but necessary process of anchoring our nation in these turbulent times. With the Republican Convention in full swing, you’re probably getting a lot of emails right now.

[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=9a6a117b63904dc9bbd1634b54c6394e&_e=wjovcSz74rGR4osTAsS3t2PUNaSfiWuM6dc6YbCOAC0M0u7dGGrRr8vv6MShzXBHguzsmxSql8mbtqvepokr5hVs_0FyBBemJMYMQu_FxB992-HODYfUlzcT4N7YcKDI0b52AFhNCFDYYqi7QnqTFffreRP8PSxi_efQgXTaAUAWJrG3MlNPV4_Kw7z457i3hiy9sv7CPFyDJ3aS4QycT98v40-g4uZnKPFrvZXcw6yCJ1Lt5kPxf6NAhRyIFqj4kjeQBftF4l_b_hFcRDAa8tDRA7ttuu78u3g_PHFtazWxOvr_u4vNhD6MnJQ5GkIUdy49V4aIypQNMNL44IO14pfezAZ9lo6C33yYG5YIwSokRE71Wea1ZcG4TNPB2TUCh69HHFfA36FMfOVuTFBY2Q%3D%3D)

Dear Friend,

Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **[National Survey on the Department of Justice](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=9a6a117b63904dc9bbd1634b54c6394e&_e=wjovcSz74rGR4osTAsS3t2PUNaSfiWuM6dc6YbCOAC0M0u7dGGrRr8vv6MShzXBHguzsmxSql8mbtqvepokr5hVs_0FyBBemJMYMQu_FxB992-HODYfUlzcT4N7YcKDI0b52AFhNCFDYYqi7QnqTFffreRP8PSxi_efQgXTaAUAWJrG3MlNPV4_Kw7z457i3hiy9sv7CPFyDJ3aS4QycT98v40-g4uZnKPFrvZXcw6x9wUUOI6jbx8HfCi09uRFSMEL_zEBG5KPpwZd5UbPJM8p8tMgcqvB8bpmyP3GTflX91ubvuGpapqKgP8HHUcZ9uEza75ozu3BlcWuG2yBM3fzBNfL7IMNgGA2M15-uwR-QBbfVlCmSmykJv0iA-TjkJd02JqKrwsuaALXOO9OKog%3D%3D).**

The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America.

**The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.**

Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents...

...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties.

At the same time, with the help of the media it...

Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the [Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=9a6a117b63904dc9bbd1634b54c6394e&_e=wjovcSz74rGR4osTAsS3t2PUNaSfiWuM6dc6YbCOAC0M0u7dGGrRr8vv6MShzXBHguzsmxSql8mbtqvepokr5hVs_0FyBBemJMYMQu_FxB992-HODYfUlzcT4N7YcKDI0b52AFhNCFDYYqi7QnqTFffreRP8PSxi_efQgXTaAUAWJrG3MlNPV4_Kw7z457i3hiy9sv7CPFyDJ3aS4QycT98v40-g4uZnKPFrvZXcw6xBEgFmyWsaX9U0HElea6da_oPz3DUx4ceSjYOkWC7IST6nCrDxFaBZHtmKCWRLnMzam4oY0PrCnHYLLnpDe6VruCfythnbG4cgTovv5KCU5SIpx4iAM91FBztRhGaJGsIfLEsfaiNIug9qwJLWAIQxwDJt-LugRLspJfkVmDxZog%3D%3D).**

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption.

Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=9a6a117b63904dc9bbd1634b54c6394e&_e=wjovcSz74rGR4osTAsS3t2PUNaSfiWuM6dc6YbCOAC0M0u7dGGrRr8vv6MShzXBHguzsmxSql8mbtqvepokr5hVs_0FyBBemJMYMQu_FxB992-HODYfUlzcT4N7YcKDI0b52AFhNCFDYYqi7QnqTFffreRP8PSxi_efQgXTaAUAWJrG3MlNPV4_Kw7z457i3hiy9sv7CPFyDJ3aS4QycT98v40-g4uZnKPFrvZXcw6zxOwkA-0M_qOjfYOBsAH36EDt_4hZakeiTBC8p5k-NdyozxvaJhac37lEgaCket9rveXy-jx-SGv7f3OEHDGIh_1ZglHD68g2lQGPd98q1KGiRdXtTAeDntVDgjIBOmg5vD88JDiVsRoXlhOCbvGhZrlxwo_gDFgkrR88YEuK8vw%3D%3D)**

The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.**

Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack.

**You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.**

A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.**

These efforts include:

**Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

So please share your views by completing our [**National Survey on the Department of Justice**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=9a6a117b63904dc9bbd1634b54c6394e&_e=wjovcSz74rGR4osTAsS3t2PUNaSfiWuM6dc6YbCOAC0M0u7dGGrRr8vv6MShzXBHguzsmxSql8mbtqvepokr5hVs_0FyBBemJMYMQu_FxB992-HODYfUlzcT4N7YcKDI0b52AFhNCFDYYqi7QnqTFffreRP8PSxi_efQgXTaAUAWJrG3MlNPV4_Kw7z457i3hiy9sv7CPFyDJ3aS4QycT98v40-g4uZnKPFrvZXcw6w10SRZu5a_yb_CS8JyHWpbRUmoW9YAuU-USxJZ9M7jP2xPlDoBy0RHL_wcJiw8bIe2A1MFg7shyyxipwK1hUw4nNd5A7YyiHG1sDo5sw1qZMrKP4pzu7i5liLCII7Db4U3UPPRpm9cHXTJ4mVQYaEvCHnparY5WubAHaHN4GViNQ%3D%3D) and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

**This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=9a6a117b63904dc9bbd1634b54c6394e&_e=wjovcSz74rGR4osTAsS3t2PUNaSfiWuM6dc6YbCOAC0M0u7dGGrRr8vv6MShzXBHguzsmxSql8mbtqvepokr5hVs_0FyBBemJMYMQu_FxB992-HODYfUlzcT4N7YcKDI0b52AFhNCFDYYqi7QnqTFffreRP8PSxi_efQgXTaAUAWJrG3MlNPV4_Kw7z457i3hiy9sv7CPFyDJ3aS4QycT98v40-g4uZnKPFrvZXcw6xXfj2FMVQxkQSatrq5lycDOBrTeTn87nXY96RDpq9XNGo-WjiAG0dpsaf3sq-QdeYhnGoAM1syRvBOPZPstyHKLL06mvGCtGZwofmBqgSCAm01eH3xs22Lkig2j_BtQrq08y-Tp8EqGyrKDWifVQr9aGVItw1J3wnfyUo4EQV1mg%3D%3D)**

Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

name: Matt Diemer
subject: J.D. Vance needs to tone down his rhetoric
body:
| |
---
Peter, J.D. Vance has officially been chosen as Donald Trump’s running mate. We’ve been talking a lot about out-of-control rhetoric recently, and I fully agree we need to tone it down. And J.D. Vance has had the strongest political rhetoric of anyone. Vance has used incredibly damaging language to describe the former President. He called Trump an "idiot" and said Trump was "reprehensible." He described Donald as “cultural heroin” and a “cynical asshole.” Using that kind of extreme language about our Republican nominee could be incredibly dangerous. America deserves better than politicians who insult instead of engaging in substantive debate. **Vance even went so far as to call Trump “America’s Hitler.”** Rhetoric like that is never okay. We can do better than insults and extreme comparisons. I really hope J.D. Vance will tone down his rhetoric so we can have a healthier democracy. body:
We’re in a moment of national reflection.

| | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zcuoi9t914pkjf012ek9j4tof3tci4gf01b1uthg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4chim4o72c1h2bs)

Friend, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Friend, over the past year, I wrote my new book,****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

_[**Can I send you a FREE copy of**** _Right Wing Revolution_****to read today? All I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning Point USA --and our critically important work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again.**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zenp8gmpgekcagcdho3agdbpe2sv4urscvbfseeg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4chim4o72c1h2bs)_

---
Friend, I'm proud to say that _Right Wing Revolution_ is like NO OTHER book you've read from the Right before:
* It's NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between Left and Right.

* It's NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American.

* It's NOT a call for __ our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference - instead, its focus is on __ how _all Americans_ can improve our country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving _ourselves_.

**I want to get my new book in the hands of as many Americans as possible --which is why I'm offering to send you a hardcover edition for FREE.** _**[All I ask for in return is your gift of ANY amount to help support Turning Point USA's work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again!](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zg8fu67pjddv7s7mrulttkbpv9174mpfjand0mho_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4chim4o72c1h2bs)**_

Dahlstrom Leads Republican Fundraising for Q2 in AK-AL Congressional
Race
*|MC_PREVIEW_TEXT|*

View this email in your browser

<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=70191&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC

July 16, 2024
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
CONTACT: Houston Keene
press@nancyforalaska.com

Dahlstrom Leads Republican Fundraising for Q2 in AK-AL Congressional
Race

ANCHORAGE, AK - Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom brought in nearly $400,000
in support of her congressional race during the 2nd quarter of 2024.
This brings Dahlstrom's total to over $865,000 raised in just 7 months
of her campaign. She was the top Republican fundraiser for the 3rd
quarter in a row and sits on more than $605,000 cash-on-hand, by far
the most of any Republican in the race.

The strong fundraising quarter comes on the heels of the endorsement of
President Trump, who posted his support of Nancy Dahlstrom on June 17.
President Trump joined a growing list of high-profile endorsements
including Governor Mike Dunleavey, Speaker Mike Johnson, and Chairwoman
Elise Stefanik.

"Lt. Governor Dahlstrom has the resources, support, and infrastructure
to beat Mary Peltola in November. We are proud to be building a
campaign that is positioned to flip this seat and look forward to
continuing to travel the state to share our Alaska-first message with
others," stated Justine Jaenisch, campaign manager for Nancy Dahlstorm.

Nancy for Alaska Toplines:

* Top Republican Fundraiser: Nancy posted the highest quarterly
number of any Republican running this cycle. She has outraised all
Republicans each quarter she has been a candidate.
* Strong Cash-on-Hand: Nancy enters the heart of the campaign
with over $605,000 cash-on-hand, 2.5x more than the closest Republican.
She has built a campaign that raises significantly more than it spends,
giving her a strong cash-on-hand number heading into November.
* Outside Support: Outside groups that have endorsed Nancy
Dahlstrom have reserved $4.5 million on television, recognizing Nancy
is the best positioned Republican to defeat Peltola in November.

name: Charlie Kirk, TPUSA
subject: Can I send you my new book?
body:
We’re in a moment of national reflection.

| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4hhcuc8efeg805otb411pms3roqhr3a7mfb4s48_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4chim2or0cth2bs)
---
Friend, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Friend, over the past year, I wrote my new book,****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

_[**Can I send you a FREE copy of**** _Right Wing Revolution_****to read today? All I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning Point USA --and our critically important work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdhh595hn0vpd8glrh83s1vorb4tk848oghufui8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4chim2or0cth2bs)_
---
[**Make your gift & get your FREE book**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4fv0r7fm5rqpsn19gialsu5r1kpk6j7vsroet1o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4chim2or0cth2bs)
---
Friend, I'm proud to say that _Right Wing Revolution_ is like NO OTHER book you've read from the Right before:
* It's NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between Left and Right.

* It's NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American.

* It's NOT a call for __ our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference - instead, its focus is on __ how _all Americans_ can improve our country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving _ourselves_.

**I want to get my new book in the hands of as many Americans as possible --which is why I'm offering to send you a hardcover edition for FREE.** _**[All I ask for in return is your gift of ANY amount to help support Turning Point USA's work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again!](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvdkjdmosl7i5e9pshdcmvnna26k5kn07t98asg0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4chim2or0cth2bs)**_

---

Peter,
Our campaign talks a lot about fundraising and how critical it is to have the resources necessary to continue delivering for the Commonwealth. So today, we want to take a moment to explain _what_ we are delivering.
With so much on the line this November, it’s crucial that we lay out a strong platform that covers critical issues. We have three key pillars we are focusing on this November:

2. **Women’s rights. Access to birth control, family planning services, and more are at stake, and our opponent makes no promises to protect them. Our team, on the other hand, is working to make sure these rights are codified for women across the Commonwealth and the Nation.**

subject: Who rules whom?
body:

Hillsdale College

Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its
National Referendum on the Administrative State.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osiLKdbWNA

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Fellow American,

Hillsdale College has selected you to
participate in its National Referendum on the Administrative
State.

Responding will only take a few
minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right
away…because our country is facing a constitutional
crisis.

It's a crisis that involves a
fundamental political question: who rules whom?

The Constitution established a limited
government in which the people ruled through their elected
officials. Under this form of government, America became the
freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional
system is one that increasingly exists in name only.

The Constitution of "We the People" is
being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable
administrative state that rules without the consent of American
citizens.

This means we live in an era of growing
bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state
that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers,
and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

But we can't just TALK about the
problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION-to DO SOMETHING about it,
while there's still time to save our country.

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to
returning to the Constitution of "We the People"-before it's too
late.

To do that, I need your input. What are
your opinions on this topic-knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS
that will restore liberty?

Please let me know your thoughts today
by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State
using this secure link:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63393031:siLKdbWNA:m:3:2627245898:4FFBA5ED0C043DC46F0D7A66BB0A0E6C:r

When you send in your survey, I hope
you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a
tax-deductible gift.

The rise of the administrative state is
a grave threat to our country.

To counter this threat, Hillsdale
sponsors several educational outreach efforts-including Imprimis,
free online courses, programs on our Washington, D.C., campus,
and a growing network of classical K-12 schools and
homeschoolers-to teach citizens about the meaning of the
Constitution and the importance of our founding principles of
liberty.

Your gift of at least $15-or even $25,
$35, $50, $100, or more if you're especially motivated to TAKE
ACTION-will help us to expand these educational initiatives that
are reaching and teaching millions.

Your support of these efforts is
essential because Hillsdale refuses to take ONE PENNY of
government funding.

So please complete your National
Referendum on the Administrative State and consider giving your
most generous tax-deductible contribution.

Thank you for being on the side of the
Constitution and liberty!

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty
Since 1844

P.S. I look forward to receiving your
opinions about what's happening in our nation. And I hope that
you can support our work.

So please complete the National
Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63393031:siLKdbWNA:m:3:2627245898:4FFBA5ED0C043DC46F0D7A66BB0A0E6C:r

As soon as you respond, we will begin
your FREE lifetime subscription to Imprimis, Hillsdale's digest
of liberty that you will receive via email ten times a year. If
you'd like, you can also sign up to receive the publication
through postal mail.

Educating millions about the
Constitution to counter the threat from the administrative state
is a monumental task. That's why when you complete your survey, I
hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a
tax-deductible gift.

Thank you for your time and
attention-and for your commitment to liberty.

49242 USA

body:

Did you see the news, friend? **Donald Trump just announced his pick for vice president, and it’s my fellow Ohio Senator, J.D. Vance.**
Here’s what this means for our race:
1\. Donald Trump and the entire GOP establishment are laser-focused on flipping my seat red because they know it’ll decide Senate control.

**For Immediate Release:** July 16, 2024 | [Info@DravesforCongress.com](mailto:Info@DravesforCongress.com) **California Trust-Fund Candidate Paul Junge Fails to Convince a Single District Voter to Support Him** Failed California trust-fund candidate Paul Junge reported an embarrassing fundraising quarter, [receiving only $16,000](https://bpdglq.clicks.mlsend.com/td/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjk2MDc0MixcImxcIjoxMjcwMjgyOTc3NjM2NTI5MjYsXCJyXCI6MTI3MDI4MzAzMjQ4NzU0MDQ1fSIsInMiOiIwMWJhNzIzZjUwZGIyMjJlIn0) from individual donors, none of whom reside in the district he’s running to represent. Junge has proven once again that the voters of Michigan reject him, not only at the ballot box, but also financially. Despite running his third campaign for the same seat, Junge’s support in the district is so weak he has had to rely on $2 million of his own inherited trust-fund to keep the operation going. His campaign is increasingly reminiscent of his 2022 run where he loaned himself $1.1 million and still lost by 10 points. Paul Junge's abysmal fundraising record is yet another reminder that he doesn't have what it takes to win in the fall. He has spent his inherited wealth on himself, NOT to help President Trump win this district, NOT to help other Michigan Republicans, and _not even to invest in Michigan businesses and jobs_. In contrast, Mary Draves reported revenues of over $520,000, raising more than half from Michigan voters. Despite being a first-time candidate and launching her campaign just three months ago, Mary immediately endorsed President Trump and has garnered support from business owners and leaders in the community who know she is the only candidate capable of delivering for MI-08. “It’s clear the voters of Michigan's 8th district aren’t buying what anti-Trump Paul Junge is selling. Only FOUR Michiganders donated to Paul’s vanity run this quarter, and none of them even live in the district. How can Michigan voters trust Junge to work hard for them when he won't even work hard now as a candidate?" Daves said. “I’m honored to have the support of nearly 200 individual donors who know I will do the hard work to fight for Mid-Michigan in D.C. because #MidMichiganMatters.”

As the daughter of a union meat-cutter, a single mother who experienced homelessness, and a survivor of multiple forms of violence, Cori’s journey to Congress was sparked by a tragedy in Ferguson, Missouri. | | Peter, the recent incident of political violence has shaken our country to its very core. These acts of aggression do more than just harm individuals—they threaten the very fabric of our democracy. This is not the America we aspire to be. For generations, we have strived to build a nation based on the principles of justice, equality, and peace, and the violent event we witnessed this past weekend is a stark reminder that our work is far from over. Now more than ever, we must rally together and show the world that we will not be intimidated by those who seek to divide us. It is crucial that we stand united and turn out in historic numbers once again to support leaders who champion peace and democracy, like Joe Biden, Kamala Harris, and Tammy Baldwin. **I need your help to make this happen:** Your contribution today will help us continue our mission against political violence and ensure a safer, more just future for all Americans. **[**Every dollar you donate brings us one step closer to preserving the progress we've made and building the future we dream of.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88971305/485751911/-2102814902?refcode=0716&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85MzczOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MjY2MTk0Ny04OTQzLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HLoxzuMUkS-YFlHAgMG0f7ytVssi7uEf04EEJXSBc2w=)**

body:

# There is no Plan B
---
| Hello Peter,
If Donald Trump and his lock-step buddy, Buddy remain in power, **life as we know it will never be the same.** Thanks to my opponent’s support, **Georgia has one of the most severe, anti-woman abortion laws on the books.**
**I say, enough is enough!**
With a republican win,**it will get even worse in Coastal Georgia** and across the country. Just imagine...
**...Anti-choice, anti-women laws will become ironclad,** compelling every pregnant woman (and girl) to give forced birth — regardless of the threat to mother or child. With no exceptions for rape or incest.
**...Contraception will be outlawed,** increasing economic hardship for families, and pushing dreams of college or career beyond the reach of many.
**...Helping a pregnant, spouse, daughter or even friend could become a criminal act** for you and me, and a capital crime for our already harassed healthcare workers.
**Enough is enough!**
As a mother and grandmother — I am running for Congress **to fight so women in Coastal Georgia can have the freedom to make their own medical choices.**
**I will fight for you until the very end.** I promise. But I can’t do it alone. My opponent has a war chest fattened by old-money guys who write big checks, corporate “buddies,” and overwhelming powers that come from spending so many years in Washington.
That’s why I hope you can join me in fighting for the **FREEDOM** of all Georgia women [**by making a gift of $10, $20, $40, or even a most generous gift of $100 or more.**](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=ff4e9d892c&e=0f456155ff)
**My opponent doesn’t respect you or your doctors,** your family members, your minister, or even your spouse to make your most personal, most sacred decisions. **I do.**
**If you have had enough,** make a gift that can help me ensure that your voice is heard. Please visit [**Patti For Georgia**](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=c003176f94&e=0f456155ff) today to join the movement.
-Patti

subject: Beyond the Mississippi Swindle - Shad White kicks off our Fall Speaker Series
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/myvisionforms-11572831?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Good morning Friend,

We are kicking off our fall Speaker Series with none other than Mississippi’s State Auditor, Shad White, for an exclusive discussion on some of the most pressing issues facing our state, on September 19th at the Country Club of Jackson.
---
| [ ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=275245a795&e=5703353baa)
---
_Click above to purchase your tickets!_
| **Why You Should Attend:**
1. **Discover "The Mississippi Swindle":** Shad White will share insights from his new book, uncovering shocking stories of financial mismanagement and corruption in Mississippi. This is a must-read for anyone passionate about transparency and accountability in our state.
2. **Addressing K-12 Administrative Waste:** Our education system is plagued with inefficiencies. Shad will break down where the waste is happening and how we can redirect those resources to benefit our students and teachers directly.
3. **The Role of DEI in Public Universities:** Dive into a critical analysis of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion programs in our public universities. How are these initiatives affecting academic standards and campus culture?

This event isn’t just about listening—it’s about engaging in meaningful dialogue and finding solutions. Whether you're a concerned parent, an educator, or simply someone who cares about the future of Mississippi, your voice matters. **RSVP[here](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=0c1566df2a&e=5703353baa) **to reserve your spot and join us for this important conversation.

As always, I am looking forward to seeing you there!
---
| |
---
Warmest wishes,

Anika Page
Director of Operations

There are students on roughly **981** college campuses who need us to step up.

clean_body: | Hey team — There are students on roughly 981 college campuses who need us to step up. Here’s the issue: Since 2013, we’ve amplified the political power of thousands of students across the country. We’ve turned out more young voters than we can count and encouraged them to take a stand for our rights and democracy. But far-right extremists are determined to stop young voters from making their voices heard. From changing voter ID laws to attempts at removing polling locations from college campuses, MAGA zealots will stop at nothing to keep the youth vote from making a difference at the polls. They know that progress is made possible by creating a community of engaged young people ready to take action, and they’re fighting like hell to stop us. But here’s what we’ve learned: If even one student on one campus wants to make a difference, there’s nothing the far-right can do to stop them. Through campus organizing, we’ve been able to bring attention to key issues like climate change and abortion access to the young voters moving our country forward. Together, we can inspire the next generation of leaders and activists to step up and uplift our communities, but we need your help. | | | | | | Together, NextGen PAC | Paid for by NextGen Climate Action Committee; ; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. | = |

Trump's selection of J.D. Vance, Ohio's Republican Senator, makes holding the Senate more difficult.

In just a moment, I am going to ask you to make a contribution directly to Senator Sherrod Brown's re-election campaign in Ohio. Please give me a chance to explain why this request — especially today — is so important.
Here is the truth:
No matter what happens in the presidential race, it is critical for Democrats hold onto the Senate. And there is no doing that if Sherrod Brown loses in Ohio.
Trump's selection of J.D. Vance, Ohio's Republican Senator, makes that more difficult. It puts a spotlight on Ohio. It will motivate Ohio Republicans to vote.
It also means the race will attract even more outside spending trying to defeat Sherrod Brown.
That will happen because Republicans know what we know: if Sherrod Brown goes down, Republicans will take control of the Senate.
So this is an all-hands-on deck moment for Democrats who know the importance of this moment, and the importance of holding the Senate.

| | Dear Fellow American, American civics education, and specifically the teaching of American history, is at a crisis point. In K-12 schools nationwide, false narratives are being constructed, and content is being cherry-picked to fit an ideological (and frankly anti-American) agenda. Maybe you've even seen this happening in your local schools. As a result, we are faced with a choice: will we allow our children to be indoctrinated using curricula developed by anti-American ideologues and promoted by Left-wing education bureaucrats? Or will we insist that our children are taught honestly, using a curriculum that presents a fair, unbiased, and comprehensive view of our nation's history? We must insist on the **latter** , both for the sake of truth and for the sake of our children and America's future. For this reason, we have produced the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ --and I'm writing to ask your help in promoting this curriculum to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide. **What is the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_? ** The**_Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_** is a K-12 history and civics curriculum that covers the triumphs and tragedies of American history fairly and comprehensively. This curriculum has been designed not by activists or ideologues but by teachers and professors at Hillsdale College--and we are making it available **free of charge**. To be clear, the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ is not a _slap-dash_ response to the efforts of anti-American ideologues to indoctrinate our children. It is a 2,000-page, 85-lesson curriculum based on decades of studying American history. Developed over 18 months of intense and focused effort, its roots extend as far back as the beginning of Hillsdale College in 1844. And we need your help to make the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ available to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide...and to make it available **free of charge** so that it will have the greatest impact. _We have set a budget goal of $800,000 to promote the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ and our other outreach efforts--including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and our classical K-12 charter school initiative_. That's an ambitious budget, and we need to get started as soon as possible. One reason why your support really matters: **Hillsdale College refuses to accept one penny in taxpayer support --not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans**. This makes our work uniquely dependent on the support of citizens like you--citizens who agree with Hillsdale's mission on behalf of liberty. We remind ourselves daily of Hillsdale's 180-year-old mission--to provide "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty." With that mission in mind, we produced the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ --and now we need your help to promote it nationwide. Will you take this opportunity to _**support the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_ and our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty**_**?** Understanding that a proper education is vital to the preservation of liberty--and that the anti-American indoctrination now being forced on too many American children poses an existential threat to liberty--I hope you will make your most generous tax-deductible gift today. **I 've included a secure link for your convenience here: ** _**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-hillsdale-1776-curriculum](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=80b0adbb9e4c453bba7fb52e0f95f6c5&_e=VEM6JXtE76BT13OVg0i70mio2o-JDrII_nddxP7qZjSXVaMKcBG6k_ou3Rc8w61oAZo4K_N_OLppYPdvmgwP6wUedTN2i3OhmbERoOO8A2ySVkFhYQFQEWagEDG-_6Ikgt7FDIRlLP-VYEz86vx3iSKA1To2_2vpDfmN99lQetlBgW2IpMcE3GDxtE5-VuhLxNeTOlaLn1IGrOlFEKcP3_dbJb6GRbHW3jm15LU8coHcoOpOyCntcEWfM23V5o6kKLbF-eXwMPbBEBY7e2aQEpXy6rhYd4q72HIIg1Xj7gkzsbLCQaQZMIAXqp7MnRqIs6LWXvd4DhRe5f281Y0cFQgWN6tOd5Lu6n2_-GcZygxlRLmhjRqAad4l-Fq6MNhbORtdeZkY43Q_fhvpoUL2bIbBdjIhVJ3crks8Jn1IUrM%3D)**_ Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to hearing from you. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

name: Andrew Yang
subject: JD Vance
body:
Yesterday Donald Trump selected JD Vance, the Ohio Senator, as his running mate. I got a sinking feeling when I heard the news. | |
---
| | |
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=e9d5f349a2&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
---
| Yesterday Donald Trump selected JD Vance, the Ohio Senator, as his running mate.

I got a sinking feeling when I heard the news.

There were others whom Trump could have chosen for different reasons.

Doug Burgum would have been a steady business hand with massive resources. Glenn Youngkin would have reassured moderates and corporate donors. Nikki Haley would have done the same and appealed to women. Marco Rubio would have held demographic appeal and foreign policy chops.

JD Vance is a different kind of choice as a governing partner and now heir apparent to the MAGA movement. He doesn’t have massive stature on Capitol Hill – his legislation has generally not gone anywhere. He doesn’t add that much electoral appeal; Vance underperformed in Ohio which isn’t a swing state anyway. He’s disliked by many. He’s not the fundraising magnet that some others are.

What he does have is an actual perspective and thoughts. He’s a hard right populist who went to Yale Law. Among his stances:
* He wouldn’t have certified the 2020 election.
* “I don’t really care what happens to Ukraine one way or another.”
* “If you wanted to kill a bunch of MAGA voters in the middle of the heartland, how better than to target them and their kids with this deadly fentanyl... it does look intentional. It’s like Joe Biden wants to punish the people who didn’t vote for him.”
* “Culture war is class war.”
* “We are in a late republican period... If we’re going to push back against it, we’re going to have to get pretty wild, and pretty far out there, and go in directions that a lot of conservatives right now are uncomfortable with.”

---
|
---
| JD Vance is an alienated darling of the center-left establishment from his time as author of “Hillbilly Elegy.” He began as an institutionalist, starting a venture capital firm and non-profit to help kids in Ohio, and then quickly ditched them to pursue political power in a red state. He’s a never Trumper turned ultimate always Trumper. He won his primary with only 32% of the vote thanks to Trump’s endorsement.

He’s 39 years old and has a deep relationship with Donald Trump Jr. He’s going to be with us a long time.

This is the kind of VP pick you make if you think you’re already going to win and want to inhabit the movement with a philosophy and next-generation leader. For those who hoped that MAGA would fade when Trump passed from the scene, those hopes are going to be futile. If they win in November, Trump has ensured a long-term transformation of the Republican Party in his image. His kids might not have been up for it, but JD Vance is. Trump’s movement will outlive him.

If you want to build a new movement to bring the country together, please check out [Forward](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=df7848f8f9&e=0f227c2ae3) – we are growing quickly. If you want to encourage the Dems to move on from Joe Biden, go to [passthetorchbiden.com](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=eb40db9f6e&e=0f227c2ae3). The margin of victory or defeat will matter.
---
| **
Andrew Yang**
Co-Chair, Forward Party

Larry Hogan and I disagree on a lot of things, and here are three big areas where we differ:

_I believe abortion should be safe, legal, and accessible for everyone, but Hogan disagrees._

**During his time as governor, he vetoed legislation to expand abortion access, and you'd better believe he'd pave the way for Senate Republicans to pass a national abortion ban. He was even so condescending as to belittle abortion as "_an emotional issue for women._ "**

_I believe that workers' rights should be expanded, and unions given more power to collectively bargain, but Hogan disagrees._

**He vetoed a law that would have allowed workers to deduct union dues from state income taxes.**

_I believe that we can and should be doing more to improve the lives of working Marylanders, but again, Hogan disagrees._

Energy & Experience
Every day, I wake up more energized than the day before, ready to fight for the hardworking people of Northern Michigan and the UP. The fuel I get from our supporters drives our campaign, and I couldn’t be more grateful to have you in my corner.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julyad [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julyad]
We have some massive projects rolling that require a lot of resources. I need your help in the next 20 days to have a huge impact the Aug. 6th Democratic primary and propel us to victory in November. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julyad]
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julyad]
Friends,
We’re knocking on thousands and thousands of doors, making 10s of thousands of phone calls, writing postcards, traveling from county to county in the largest Congressional districts east of the Mississippi.
Fueled by you, I've done it with vigor, grit, and tenacity for 35 months. And we are not stopping!
My team and I wake up before dawn, campaign all day, visit folks at coffee shops, pavilions, and parks, run in parades, stand up and speak out loudly for the policies that we know rural Michigan cares about.
For all generations, we’re fighting for:
Affordable housing, childcare, universal pre-K, two-year tuition-free college, environmental protection, healthcare for all, LGBTQ protections, and reproductive rights.
Family sustainable wages, a labor revolution, small business success, local farming support, immigration reform, and economic mobility for everyone.
I will not stop fighting for this cause until everyone gets a fair shake.
Before Tues. Aug 6, I’m asking for your support — your faith in the experience and energy that it will require to get the job done.
I’ve got 30 years of public service experience and decades to go, and I’ve never been more fired up to do my part in creating a system that works for all.
Friend, we have the best opportunity to win in November, but first we must win big in August to show our strength. It’s time to move Michigan’s 1st district forward.
Join us.
Onward,
-Bob

Northern Michigan / Upper Peninsula
Democrat, MI01

body:

| | **Can't see this message?_[View in a browser](https://www.domjones.org/so/a2P2yTa4Y/c?w=yAfjJSHaGsh-DEuLAM8bB4LagMUKYzRa8TBUr9fxKe0.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZG9tam9uZXMub3JnL3NvL2EyUDJ5VGE0WT9sYW5ndWFnZVRhZz1lbiIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjUxYmIxNzQ0LTJhOTMtNDMwYy04YzQ3LTA4MDY4MDZkZDFjMiJ9)_**

| | |

| | Sunday July 14, 2024
---
| |
---
| | A STATEMENT FROM CALIFORNIA STATE ASSEMBLY CANDIDATE DOM JONES ON THE RECENT POLITICAL VIOLENCE IN BUTLER, PENNSYLVANIA
---
| | Dear Fellow Americans, As a candidate for the California State Assembly in Orange County, I, Dom Jones, stand firmly against all forms of violence, especially political violence. The recent incidents at political rallies are a stark reminder of how deeply our divisions have grown and the dire need for a return to kindness and understanding in our public discourse. We must remember that our strength as a community and a nation lies in our ability to listen to one another, to empathize with differing perspectives, and to engage in constructive dialogue. Violence, in any form, has no place in our society and only serves to deepen the rifts between us. I stand for all people, regardless of political ideology, and I believe that love and respect should guide our actions and conversations. The hatred and vitriol that have become commonplace in our political landscape are unacceptable. We must reject this path and choose instead to build bridges, foster mutual respect, and promote peace. My campaign is dedicated to promoting equity, justice, and the well-being of every individual in our community. I urge us all to exercise kindness and understanding above all. Together, we can create a future where every voice is heard, every person is valued, and every difference is respected. Let us move forward with the power of love and the strength of unity. Together, we can overcome the challenges we face and build a brighter, more inclusive future for all. I send warm, loving blessings to our nation. Your Future California State Assemblywoman, Dom Jones
---
| | | [**Support Dom In Building Unity**](https://www.domjones.org/so/a2P2yTa4Y/c?w=mtTJRytkAze17bOzCPG_fLb_HbC7s4km8nObvnwwW2o.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZG9tam9uZXMub3JnLyIsInIiOiIwYTAyZTRkZC0xN2IzLTQzZDAtOWMxMi0zM2RjMzAzOWYyYWYiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiI1MWJiMTc0NC0yYTkzLTQzMGMtOGM0Ny0wODA2ODA2ZGQxYzIifQ)
---
| |
---
| | We must remember that we are one humanity, and the notion of separation is an illusion. Each of us reflects the other, and our politics should not dictate our worldview. Our shared humanity is what truly unites us. Let us all come together in unity, embracing our common bond and fostering a community built on love, respect, and understanding. - Dom Jones

# **July 16th Newsletter**

---
Dear neighbors,
---
| | On Saturday, July 13th, 2024, our nation experienced an unexpected and shocking event - a violent attempt on the life of a former president who is also a current candidate for the presidency of the United States. I want to reiterate what I said then and what I believe now; there is no room for political violence in our country. This senseless act of violence led to a loss of life, and numerous injuries, including those sustained by innocent attendees of the event and former President Trump. This heinous event has left lasting emotional scars that our nation can never forget. Our nation is better than what we witnessed on Saturday and we must come together to ensure no such event occurs in the future.
---
| |
# **Housing Commission**
---
On Monday, July 15th, my colleagues and I serving on the Virginia Housing Commission met to receive the quarterly update on population trends, the economy, and eviction diversion efforts. Click [here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88979281/485777551/1714694982?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MDgzOWJlNC05NDQzLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=j-wN4NNLxwOXgN-FXYU37LBXINlZjmW1vaiLD0G7dSU=&emci=5cc651b7-7b43-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=40839be4-9443-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=21796801), to review meeting materials and video archive.

# **Below, please find information of note for the residents of the 25th District.**
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
* **Shifts in Population:**
* Similar to Northern Virginia, most of the country’s largest metropolitan areas have experienced out-migration similar to since 2020.
* For the first time since the 1970s, rural counties and small metropolitan areas have become the top destinations for Americans to move.
* In the Commonwealth of Virginia, smaller metropolitan areas and rural counties have seen in-migration rise since 2020.
* **Home Prices:**
* Individuals are moving to areas where they can afford a home.
* The median house price in Virginia is $430,000.
* The difference in housing prices between Northern Virginia and the rest of Virginia is high by historical standards.
* Home values and rent in Northern Virginia counties are among the highest in the country, outside California.

---
| | **Definition:** The **"lock-in" effect** occurs when homeowners are hesitant to sell their home because they have a very low mortgage rate that they would have to give up. This is often the case when they would have to take on a mortgage with a higher rate.
---
| |
* **Mortgage Rates:**
* In 2022, mortgage rates more than doubled in less than a year.
* In October 2023, we hit our highest interest rate since October 2000.
* The average mortgage rate for a Virginia homeowner locked in is 4.0 percent.
* The average mortgage rate for a new 30-year fixed rate with Fannie Mae is 7.0 percent.

---
---
* **Housing Inventory:**
* Inventory remains tight due to the lock-in effect but it is better than last year.
* We remain in a market where there is more demand than supply.
* Prince William County is the **ONLY** locality in the Commonwealth with less than a month’s housing supply.
* Today, the statewide median time to sell a home is 7 days. In May 2019, the statewide median time to sell a home was 13 days.

---

# Special Session July 18th
---
Thank you to all who called, texted, or emailed our office to share your perspective on the Virginia Military Survivors and Dependents Education Program (VMSDEP). I remain committed as ever to ensuring that we honor the service of our veterans and ensure the needs of veterans and their families are met. ** ** I remain in contact with numerous impacted families, many of whom call the 25th House District home. While the past few months have been filled with frustration, stress, and anxiety, please find comfort in knowing that I have always stood with our military heroes, first responders, and their families and will continue to do so. That includes ensuring VMSDEP will continue to be an earned educational benefit for military and veteran families for years to come.Members of the Virginia House of Delegates and the State Senate will return to Richmond on Thursday, July 18th, to pass legislation ensuring a full repeal of the May 2024 changes to VMSDEP. On Tuesday, July 2nd, Senate Finance and Appropriations Chair L. Louise Lucas and House Appropriations Chairman Luke E. Torian announced their plan to introduce identical legislation, [HB6004](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88979295/485777570/-2100935565?242+ful+HB6004+pdf&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MDgzOWJlNC05NDQzLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=j-wN4NNLxwOXgN-FXYU37LBXINlZjmW1vaiLD0G7dSU=&emci=5cc651b7-7b43-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=40839be4-9443-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=21796801), and [SB6012](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88979306/485777590/-2100935565?242+ful+SB6012+pdf&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MDgzOWJlNC05NDQzLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=j-wN4NNLxwOXgN-FXYU37LBXINlZjmW1vaiLD0G7dSU=&emci=5cc651b7-7b43-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=40839be4-9443-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=21796801), to repeal changes to VMSDEP in the two-year budget. House Bill 6004 also calls for an additional $90 million in funding from Fiscal Year 2024 surplus funding on top of the $40 million previously allocated. I am proud to serve as a co-patron for the House version of the bill and support its passage.

# Girls Leading Charge Nominations
---
In honor of International Day of the Girl on October 11, 2024, the White House Gender Policy Council is seeking nominations for girls in the United States (ages 14 to 18) who are leading change by tackling important issues facing their communities. The White House will celebrate a selection of young leaders from applicants from around the country. If you would like to suggest someone to nominate from the 25th District, please email [DelBSewell@house.virginia.gov](mailto:DelBSewell@house.virginia.gov) with the subject “Girls Leading Change”, and why you think she would be a good candidate.

# **Transportation Updates**
---
**VRE Fare Changes: Effective July 1st 2024** The Virginia Railway Express (VRE) will make modest adjustments to its fare schedule for the first time in five years and eliminate fares for those ages 18. This means young people can ride the VRE for free! Riders under 18 who are traveling with a fair-paying adult can simply board and ride, while riders ages 11-18 will need to present a valid school, state, or VRE reduced-fare ID card. Additionally, there will be a small fare increase of about 5%. This fare increase is below inflation levels and is the first increase since 2019. A full listing off the fare changes for 2025 can be found here: [Approved VRE Full Fare Table for Fiscal Year 2025](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88979313/485777604/1466180614?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MDgzOWJlNC05NDQzLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=j-wN4NNLxwOXgN-FXYU37LBXINlZjmW1vaiLD0G7dSU=&emci=5cc651b7-7b43-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=40839be4-9443-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=21796801)

The final schedule will be shared online on Monday, July 22nd.The following changes are of particular note to residents of the 25th District:

| **Crystal City Metro Station - East Entrance Groundbreaking** It was a pleasure to be on hand for the groundbreaking for the future east entrance to the Washington Metropolitan Area Transit Authority (Metro) Crystal City Metro Station. This station is one of the busiest Metro stations in the Commonwealth of Virginia averaging over 5,000 daily entries. The new station entrance at 18th Street South and Crystal Drive is scheduled to open in late 2027. It will provide improved transfers with Metrorail, VRE, OmniRide, bicycle routes, and pedestrian footpaths.
---
| | **Appointment to Northern Virginia Transportation Authority** On July 11, I was appointed to the Northern Virginia Transportation Authority. The organization is responsible for developing the long-range transportation plan for the region with emphasis placed on congestion reduction. Since the establishment of the dedicated, sustainable funding stream in 2013, the NVTA has invested $3.1 billion in 122 regional transportation projects throughout Northern Virginia. I look forward to working with colleagues at the state and local levels of government to shape Northern Virginia’s transportation for years to come.

# **Student Advisory Board: Call for Applicants**
---
The Student Advisory Board is a highly competitive group comprised of one student from every Superintendent’s Region in the Commonwealth. The Board works closely with the Virginia Department of Education to provide student perspectives and play a vital role in the creation of policy by the Virginia Board of Education. Students are chosen based on demonstrated academic achievement and passion for educational policy issues. The students will pick an education topic of their choosing and present suggested policy solutions to the Board of Education. Additionally, the students will have a private meeting with Governor Youngkin to present their ideas. The application opened July 1 and is due September 15. Applications are open to any rising high school senior. The Student Advisory Board will meet from 5pm to 7pm on the second Tuesday of each month beginning in October and will present to the Board of Education on June 26, 2025. The application is [available here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88979325/485777624/465363724?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MDgzOWJlNC05NDQzLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=j-wN4NNLxwOXgN-FXYU37LBXINlZjmW1vaiLD0G7dSU=&emci=5cc651b7-7b43-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=40839be4-9443-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=21796801)

clean_body: | | | July 16th Newsletter Dear neighbors, | | On Saturday, July 13th, 2024, our nation experienced an unexpected and shocking event - a violent attempt on the life of a former president who is also a current candidate for the presidency of the United States. I want to reiterate what I said then and what I believe now; there is no room for political violence in our country. This senseless act of violence led to a loss of life, and numerous injuries, including those sustained by innocent attendees of the event and former President Trump. This heinous event has left lasting emotional scars that our nation can never forget. Our nation is better than what we witnessed on Saturday and we must come together to ensure no such event occurs in the future. | | Housing Commission On Monday, July 15th, my colleagues and I serving on the Virginia Housing Commission met to receive the quarterly update on population trends, the economy, and eviction diversion efforts. Click , to review meeting materials and video archive. Below, please find information of note for the residents of the 25th District. | | | | | | Shifts in Population: Similar to Northern Virginia, most of the country’s largest metropolitan areas have experienced out-migration similar to since 2020. For the first time since the 1970s, rural counties and small metropolitan areas have become the top destinations for Americans to move. In the Commonwealth of Virginia, smaller metropolitan areas and rural counties have seen in-migration rise since 2020. Home Prices: Individuals are moving to areas where they can afford a home. The median house price in Virginia is $430,000. The difference in housing prices between Northern Virginia and the rest of Virginia is high by historical standards. Home values and rent in Northern Virginia counties are among the highest in the country, outside California. | | Definition: The "lock-in" effect occurs when homeowners are hesitant to sell their home because they have a very low mortgage rate that they would have to give up. This is often the case when they would have to take on a mortgage with a higher rate. | | Mortgage Rates: In 2022, mortgage rates more than doubled in less than a year. In October 2023, we hit our highest interest rate since October 2000. The average mortgage rate for a Virginia homeowner locked in is 4.0 percent. The average mortgage rate for a new 30-year fixed rate with Fannie Mae is 7.0 percent. Housing Inventory: Inventory remains tight due to the lock-in effect but it is better than last year. We remain in a market where there is more demand than supply. Prince William County is the ONLY locality in the Commonwealth with less than a month’s housing supply. Today, the statewide median time to sell a home is 7 days. In May 2019, the statewide median time to sell a home was 13 days. | | Special Session July 18th Thank you to all who called, texted, or emailed our office to share your perspective on the Virginia Military Survivors and Dependents Education Program (VMSDEP). I remain committed as ever to ensuring that we honor the service of our veterans and ensure the needs of veterans and their families are met. I remain in contact with numerous impacted families, many of whom call the 25th House District home. While the past few months have been filled with frustration, stress, and anxiety, please find comfort in knowing that I have always stood with our military heroes, first responders, and their families and will continue to do so. That includes ensuring VMSDEP will continue to be an earned educational benefit for military and veteran families for years to come.Members of the Virginia House of Delegates and the State Senate will return to Richmond on Thursday, July 18th, to pass legislation ensuring a full repeal of the May 2024 changes to VMSDEP. On Tuesday, July 2nd, Senate Finance and Appropriations Chair L. Louise Lucas and House Appropriations Chairman Luke E. Torian announced their plan to introduce identical legislation, , and , to repeal changes to VMSDEP in the two-year budget. House Bill 6004 also calls for an additional $90 million in funding from Fiscal Year 2024 surplus funding on top of the $40 million previously allocated. I am proud to serve as a co-patron for the House version of the bill and support its passage. | | Girls Leading Charge Nominations In honor of International Day of the Girl on October 11, 2024, the White House Gender Policy Council is seeking nominations for girls in the United States (ages 14 to 18) who are leading change by tackling important issues facing their communities. The White House will celebrate a selection of young leaders from applicants from around the country. If you would like to suggest someone to nominate from the 25th District, please email mailto:DelBSewell@house.virginia.gov with the subject “Girls Leading Change”, and why you think she would be a good candidate. | | Transportation Updates VRE Fare Changes: Effective July 1st 2024 The Virginia Railway Express (VRE) will make modest adjustments to its fare schedule for the first time in five years and eliminate fares for those ages 18. This means young people can ride the VRE for free! Riders under 18 who are traveling with a fair-paying adult can simply board and ride, while riders ages 11-18 will need to present a valid school, state, or VRE reduced-fare ID card. Additionally, there will be a small fare increase of about 5%. This fare increase is below inflation levels and is the first increase since 2019. A full listing off the fare changes for 2025 can be found here: OmniRide Schedule Changes: Effective July 29th OmniRide has announced throughout Prince William County, and several routes in the 25th district will be affected. I recognize that changes to commuter schedules can feel daunting, and want to ensure that no one is caught off guard with changes to their daily commuting routine. The final schedule will be shared online on Monday, July 22nd.The following changes are of particular note to residents of the 25th District: OmniRide Express Lake Ridge – Washington (981) New schedules are posted OmniRide Metro Express Prince William Metro Express (95) Two new stops on Potomac Mills Rd between Gideon and Smoketown Rd Local Routes Dale City (91) New stop on Potomac Mills Rd between Gideon and Smoketown Lake Ridge Connector (94) Two new stops on Potomac Mills Rd between Gideon and Smoketown Dumfries Connector (53) New stops on Potomac Mills Rd between Gideon and Smoketown | | | Crystal City Metro Station - East Entrance Groundbreaking It was a pleasure to be on hand for the groundbreaking for the future east entrance to the Washington Metropolitan Area Transit Authority (Metro) Crystal City Metro Station. This station is one of the busiest Metro stations in the Commonwealth of Virginia averaging over 5,000 daily entries. The new station entrance at 18th Street South and Crystal Drive is scheduled to open in late 2027. It will provide improved transfers with Metrorail, VRE, OmniRide, bicycle routes, and pedestrian footpaths. | | Appointment to Northern Virginia Transportation Authority On July 11, I was appointed to the Northern Virginia Transportation Authority. The organization is responsible for developing the long-range transportation plan for the region with emphasis placed on congestion reduction. Since the establishment of the dedicated, sustainable funding stream in 2013, the NVTA has invested $3.1 billion in 122 regional transportation projects throughout Northern Virginia. I look forward to working with colleagues at the state and local levels of government to shape Northern Virginia’s transportation for years to come. | | Student Advisory Board: Call for Applicants The Student Advisory Board is a highly competitive group comprised of one student from every Superintendent’s Region in the Commonwealth. The Board works closely with the Virginia Department of Education to provide student perspectives and play a vital role in the creation of policy by the Virginia Board of Education. Students are chosen based on demonstrated academic achievement and passion for educational policy issues. The students will pick an education topic of their choosing and present suggested policy solutions to the Board of Education. Additionally, the students will have a private meeting with Governor Youngkin to present their ideas. The application opened July 1 and is due September 15. Applications are open to any rising high school senior. The Student Advisory Board will meet from 5pm to 7pm on the second Tuesday of each month beginning in October and will present to the Board of Education on June 26, 2025. The application is | | Community Events Fridays at 5:** The FREE summer concert series continues with Collective playing the hits of the last 40 years. Enjoy a fun free concert with food trucks brought to you by Prince William Parks and Recreation.ELEVATE Healthcare Job Fair: July 17th, 11am-2pm. This event provides a unique opportunity for job seekers to connect with top healthcare employers in the region, explore various career paths, and find their next role in the industry. Whether you are an experienced healthcare professional or new to the field, this event is designed to support your career growth. Don't miss the chance to advance your career in healthcare! | | News You Can Use . | | Stay In Touch** Thanks again for reading our weekly update and staying in touch with our office. This morning, the _Wall Street Journal_ published an op-ed I wrote about what I witnessed during the assassination attempt at Saturday's rally in Butler, PA. Please take a minute to read it below.

* * *

**America Was an Inch From Catastrophe, and I Was There**
Dave McCormick
_Wall Street Journal_
Sunday, July 14, 2024

One inch. That's how close America came to losing Donald Trump to an assassin's bullet Saturday evening--and that inch may be a metaphor for how close we are to an internal breakdown in the greatest country the world has ever known.

The bullet that came within an inch of Mr. Trump's skull, grazing his ear, whizzed over my own head, too. I was just offstage and moments away from joining him at the podium to talk about my campaign for U.S. Senate in Pennsylvania.

I am a graduate of West Point and a veteran of the Gulf War; I'm familiar with the sound of gunfire. But it wasn't apparent in the first millisecond that the staccato crack that interrupted our Butler County rally was gunfire. Why? Because I was surrounded by thousands of fellow Americans in a celebratory, patriotic, unifying mood. It was unthinkable.

Then I saw Mr. Trump duck and grab his ear. Someone in the bleachers behind me was knocked down, and it became clear we were under fire. In the military, I learned that you can't predict how someone will respond under fire until it happens. Mr. Trump rose brilliantly to the occasion. In what will be an iconic image for the ages, he raised his fist in defiance, reassuring his countrymen, and showed true grace amid a lethal attack. He demonstrated the strength and resolve that the leader of the free world simply must have.

In the wake of the shooting, law-enforcement groups and Congress will dive into important questions about how this assassination attempt happened. How did the shooter get so close? Were Secret Service protections adequate to the threat level? Did anyone help the would-be assassin?

But these questions merely scratch the surface. What we really need to ask ourselves is how we can keep our free society from becoming a banana republic where political differences are resolved with ballistics.

Mr. Trump's critics need to acknowledge that he isn't Hitler or the devil. He's a legitimate political candidate, and the contest for the presidency should be fought over ideas and leadership traits, not through calumny that can incite violence.

That Mr. Trump is about to be nominated after winning a contested GOP primary makes his candidacy the essence of democracy. The assassin was the real threat to democracy. Mr. Trump is democracy in action.

Too many critics didn't accept Mr. Trump's first election victory in 2016 as legitimate. And since it hasn't been enough for them to disagree with Mr. Trump, they've painted him--and by extension his fellow Republicans--as a national threat that must be eliminated. The radical leftist who shot Rep. Steve Scalise (R., La.) on a baseball field in 2017 likely took this rhetoric to heart. The same may be true for the gunman who tried to assassinate Mr. Trump.

This recklessness extended beyond rhetoric to action from the highest ranks of the Democratic Party. In April, nine House Democrats, including the ranking member of the Homeland Security Committee, introduced legislation that would have stripped Mr. Trump of all Secret Service protection.

In Trump v. U.S. this month, Justice Sonia Sotomayor wrote in her dissent that a president could theoretically order the assassination of a political rival and be immune from criminal prosecution. "In every use of official power," Ms. Sotomayor wrote, "the President is now a king above the law."

Extreme rhetoric has also gained currency on the political right. It's time to stop the unending ratchet of political polemic by extremists on either side who believe their opponents' extinction is the only option. This is a political sickness, and it's spreading. It isn't manifest only in one party, and it can't be fixed by one party alone.

We need to put the engine of our republic in a constructive gear. We have consequential differences; we should debate them robustly. The left and right have vastly different visions, and both fear the consequences of losing. So let's have that conflict--but let's commit to keep it inside the context of elections, civil debate and policymaking.

As my wife, Dina, and I tell our six daughters (who until Saturday never imagined they'd have to worry about my safety), our nation's founders faced an equally fragile future. Benjamin Franklin was once asked what sort of government the Constitutional Convention had produced. Franklin's reply: "A republic, if you can keep it." His words should ring in our ears today. We may have only an inch to spare.

| _Press Release_ FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE:
**PARROTT CAMPAIGN OUTRAISES DELANEY;**
**HAS MORE CASH ON HAND**
Washington County – Federal Election Commission (FEC) reporting shows that the Parrott Campaign outraised the Delaney Campaign in the 2nd Quarter of 2024. Parrott raised $258,365 to Delaney’s $209,297.

In addition, the Parrott Campaign has more cash on hand. Parrott has $222,394 while Delaney has $217,099

Perhaps the biggest takeaway, however, is that while the vast majority of the funds raised for Parrott are from individuals inside of Maryland’s 6th Congressional District, Delaney raised less than 1% of her money from individuals living in the district.
---
| [Donate to Keep the Momentum Going](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=1d97e4ac0d&e=5a45ee1154 "Donate to Keep the Momentum Going")
---
| | Additionally, while Parrott lives in Hagerstown, the geographical center of the district he is running to represent, Delaney lives in Potomac where her drive to DC is closer than her 20-minute drive to enter the outermost part of CD-6 in Gaithersburg.

Parrott indicated, “I am extremely grateful for the strong showing of support from donors throughout District 6, and for all of the people who worked diligently to help us exceed our fundraising goal.”

On the other hand, Delaney is relying on special-interest DC PACs, her connections from her appointment in the Biden Administration, and her friends in the DC area where she lives.

While Neil Parrott plans to vote for Parrott for Congress in November, Delaney lives in CD-8 and is planning to vote for her Congressman, Jamie Raskin, who is well known as an extremely radical, left-leaning Congressmen.
---

---
| Maryland’s Congressional District 6 includes all of Garrett, Allegany, Washington and Frederick Counties as well as the northern portion of Montgomery County.

Parrott has connections within the district having represented Washington County in the Maryland House of Delegates from 2011 to 2023. He also worked in Garrett, Allegany, Washington, and Frederick Counties while working for State Highway Administration. He served as the Deputy Director of Public Works for Engineering with the City of Frederick, and then started his own traffic engineering firm that operates throughout the entire District 6.

Neil and his wife April also started Hagerstown Area Summer Swimming where Neil serves as the head coach. Over the past nine years, the low-cost program has served over 500 families in the Washington County area through swim lessons and swim team programs.

Parrott enjoys talking with voters as he goes about his day-to-day activities of work, shopping, going to church, going out to eat, and recreation.

Parrott believes that a representative in Congress should live in the district they plan to represent just like is required for all elected positions except for US Congress in the State. While serving as a Delegate, Parrott introduced a bill that would require in-district residency requirements for members of Congress in Maryland.
