# **RNC Update: MAGA Has No Solutions**
---
| | | | | [ ](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2u5rgh-e48i6d-kyd76rh4/)
---
| | | | folks, here is what you need to know about this year's RNC: On Day 1 of the Republican National Convention, J.D. Vance was appointed as Trump's running mate. Vance's strong ties to the Heritage Foundation and his track record raise serious concerns, confirming his troubling alignment with the controversial measures and policies outlined in Project 2025. A fervent sympathy for Trump among MAGA supporters erupted as they roared 'Fight, fight, fight!' as he entered the convention with his ear bandaged following the attempted assassination. The RNC began with a message of unity for all Americans, regardless of political affiliation, asserting that Republicans stand for everyone. However, it soon turned into a typical MAGA rally, demonizing undocumented immigrants and blaming Biden for soaring inflation and high gas prices. The slogans "Make America Wealthy Again" and "Drill Baby Drill" dominated the crowd but offered no real solutions. Tim Scott's speech exemplified the many flowery addresses given during the event. He claimed, “It’s conservative values that restore hope, and it’s Republican policies that lift people up,” but failed to explain how. As the day progressed, it became clear that the Republican Party is geared toward a pure MAGA agenda, relying on Christian nationalism as their guide. Scott delivered chilling rhetoric, emphasizing divine intervention and portraying Trump as an "American lion," alluding to supernatural, godlike characteristics. We have seen this behavior for too long. The MAGA base is completely swept up in Trump's cult of personality, which allows MAGA to run campaigns without offering real solutions. This year's RNC has been a continuation of that trend, and in the long run, this approach will prevent meaningful solutions to the most pressing issues facing Americans from being brought to the table. We need to call this out because if their solutions resemble anything like Project 2025, we cannot allow them to sneak such policies into law. The lack of substantive policy discussion and the focus on loyalty to Trump threaten to undermine the democratic process and prevent the addressing of critical national concerns. [**_This is our moment, Dems. We must push Democrats to unite, find common ground, and develop tangible policies. This will set us apart as a legitimate, solution-based party with real intentions to help the average American!_**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2u5rgh-e48i6e-kyd76rh5/)

| | Dom Jones, known as "Hạnh" in the Vietnamese community—a name derived from "Hạnh Phúc" meaning happiness—has a life story deeply intertwined with the Vietnamese American community. As a teenager without a home, Dom found refuge and a sense of belonging among Vietnamese Americans and a family that helped nurture her when she had no one else. This connection grew stronger during her three years of missionary service within the Vietnamese community, both in Little Saigon and Vietnam, where she lived among them, spoke their language, and dedicated herself to uplifting their spirits. Dom’s heartfelt desire to see the Vietnamese community flourish is evident in her fluency in Vietnamese and her deep cultural understanding. Her passion led her to host a show on Pho Bolsa TV Network, where she continues to inspire and connect with viewers. Now, as a candidate for California State Assembly in Coastal Orange County, Dom is committed to making the needs, education, and resources of the Vietnamese community a top priority. Team Dom Jones stands for all people, embracing the rich diversity of Orange County. Dom’s journey, shaped by her close bond with the Vietnamese community, has molded her into a leader who embodies compassion, resilience, and dedication. Her mission is to ensure that every voice is heard, every community is uplifted, and that the beautiful tapestry of American diversity is celebrated and cherished. As the next Assemblywoman, Dom Jones is determined to blaze a trail for all, especially for the community that has given her so much.

| | Dom Jones, được biết đến với cái tên “Hạnh” trong cộng đồng người Việt—tên bắt nguồn từ “Hạnh Phúc” có nghĩa là hạnh phúc—có một câu chuyện cuộc đời gắn bó sâu sắc với cộng đồng người Mỹ gốc Việt. Là một thiếu niên không nhà, Dom tìm được nơi nương tựa và cảm giác thân thuộc giữa những người Mỹ gốc Việt và một gia đình đã giúp nuôi dưỡng cô khi cô không còn ai khác. Mối liên hệ này ngày càng bền chặt hơn trong ba năm cô phục vụ truyền giáo trong cộng đồng người Việt, cả ở Little Sài Gòn và Việt Nam, nơi cô sống giữa họ, nói ngôn ngữ của họ và cống hiến hết mình để nâng cao tinh thần của họ.Mong muốn chân thành của Dom được nhìn thấy cộng đồng người Việt phát triển được thể hiện rõ qua khả năng nói tiếng Việt thông thạo và hiểu biết sâu sắc về văn hóa của cô. Niềm đam mê đã khiến cô dẫn chương trình trên Pho Bolsa TV Network, nơi cô tiếp tục truyền cảm hứng và kết nối với người xem. Giờ đây, với tư cách là ứng cử viên cho Quốc hội Tiểu bang California ở Quận Cam ven biển, Dom cam kết đặt nhu cầu, giáo dục và nguồn lực của cộng đồng người Việt lên hàng đầu.Đội Dom Jones đại diện cho tất cả mọi người, đón nhận sự đa dạng phong phú của Quận Cam. Hành trình của Dom, được hình thành từ mối liên kết chặt chẽ của cô với cộng đồng người Việt, đã hun đúc cô thành một nhà lãnh đạo thể hiện lòng nhân ái, sự kiên cường và cống hiến. Sứ mệnh của cô là đảm bảo rằng mọi tiếng nói đều được lắng nghe, mọi cộng đồng đều được nâng cao và tấm thảm đẹp về sự đa dạng của nước Mỹ được tôn vinh và trân trọng. Với tư cách là Nữ nghị sĩ tiếp theo, Dom Jones quyết tâm mở đường cho tất cả mọi người, đặc biệt là cộng đồng đã cống hiến cho cô rất nhiều.

name: Gallego for Arizona
subject: We owe you this much
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
Kari Lake is going to speak at the Republican National Convention tonight. She’ll make her case to the MAGA faithful on the biggest platform she’s ever had. After recent polling showed her neck-and-neck with Ruben, even projected to beat us now by some, you can bet that she won’t hold back.
#

Peter, in just a minute or so, we’re going to ask you to make a donation to Ruben’s campaign for U.S. Senate.
Please, let us explain why that donation is so important to our chances here in Arizona. We owe you that much.
Here’s the truth:
Yesterday, we hit our mid-month fundraising deadline. It was a critical bellwether to determine if we were on track to our goals, and it was one of the last ones before our primary ends on July 30th.
We needed to do really well in this mid-month drive, because the day it ended was the first day of the Republican National Convention. The biggest fundraising event of the entire year for the GOP— bar none. The bad news is, we came up short. The first two weeks of the month were terrible for fundraising, and we’ve fallen far, far behind where we need to be.
What makes this worse is that Kari Lake is going to speak at the Republican National Convention tonight. She’ll make her case to the MAGA faithful on the biggest platform she’s ever had. After recent polling showed her neck-and-neck with Ruben, some even projecting that she’ll beat us, you can bet that she won’t hold back. She’ll rake in donations and momentum. No doubt about it.
That is why this deadline and this moment is so important. Because right now, we're at a turning point in the race. Kari Lake could take the lead and win in Arizona — ushering in a new, MAGA controlled Senate. Or, we can raise the resources we need to fight back, defend Arizona, and stop them in their tracks.
The next part is up to you, Peter. And that’s why we’re humbly asking you:
[**Please, contribute $5, $10, or anything you can afford to Ruben Gallego’s campaign for U.S. Senate, before Kari Lake takes the stage tonight. Whatever you can give goes a long way towards helping us win in Arizona.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-july24.aPNp_S&refcode=em240716-2-160&t=1&akid=2621%2E734936%2EKK0ear)

body:
I’ll break it down: | | | Peter, let me share a few numbers: **580,000.** That’s how many DACA recipients there are today. | | Fellow American,

Every day, we seem to learn more about the agenda of the anti-American Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, to suppress conservative speech and political activity, and push their false and dishonest narratives about American history and current events.

That's why Hillsdale College launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

You'll be pleased to know that America's leading digest of liberty, _Imprimis_ , has grown to more than 6.6 million.

Today, with the radical Left increasing its efforts to undermine traditional patriotism and transform American government and society, _Imprimis_ is more important than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, the destruction of historical monuments, and the politicizing of sports by forces who believe America is fundamentally unjust.

**In response, Hillsdale College is determined to expand its national outreach efforts that reach and teach millions on behalf of liberty --including _Imprimis_. **

**Hillsdale sends _Imprimis_ ten times a year--and it does so free of charge.**

Since _Imprimis_ began in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **we have never charged for a subscription.**

And as I think you know, Hillsdale is one of only a very few American colleges that refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government support--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

This principled independence frees Hillsdale from many burdensome and corrupting federal regulations--but it also means that Hillsdale is entirely dependent on the generosity of private citizens like you who understand the importance of education to liberty.

**The only way Hillsdale can continue its work on behalf of liberty --including sending _Imprimis_ to millions of households and businesses each month--is if citizens like you continue to give us your support.**

While a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses. **

To do so, we need to address the significant printing and mailing costs of _Imprimis_. That is why I am asking you to consider helping us reach our 2024 _Imprimis_ funding goal.

[**Can I count on you to send a tax-deductible gift today to help reach this goal and to help Hillsdale expand its educational outreach efforts --including _Imprimis_?**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=679c1a457df44ffbb25367de225bccba&_e=vpeic_fKXk8rJE28f02VJ-rl7D4o4IzyafSikR7Ww49LNKcKTo_9u3eYXA-goHqLt_zxQhkwEZ43jnWQHRj0DZ6ZJ5PBgfRYc417BLV1tXnWHJtxOsYUmxTkZE1JJcS22jFrFFvoeLcdmmsnFFHBElkhhA1IqoU7TwuI5wuPyX7zcVsQ-V3oWZFzoIkVat_6BV7Ixx3T27Up_gKdO4O7l82uZibBzrFUAdmvT4ebpX4eDQ65Xt8FhMX_HLn3l3hH3nBak2bYRsO2O89DiFa3ou3m8HJRdcjSxelqPJJ4YML8PPW_crRsfvoGhiIFqMfpnN4Qz56rCPx5vcQWRYNLIn7CvXj6IMgoqcyneTjftX2V_V1uBQ0ZsHrJ_Xnloucyf669e9gi1UznkEU56hKBDQ%3D%3D)

When they talk about the climate crisis, it’s only to mock those of us who are confronting it. Their energy slogan is _Drill, Baby, Drill!_ **And if that wasn’t enough, Trump unveiled Ohio Senator J.D. Vance as his Vice Presidential pick.** Vance would be a complete disaster for our planet.

* **As a fossil fuel company shareholder, he personally benefits when oil and gas companies thrive,** raking in dividends from the soaring gas prices caused by production cuts and extreme heat last summer.
* **He is a vocal supporter of fracking.**
* **He doesn’t believe climate change is a threat.**

clean_body: It’s all on display at the Republican National Convention. | The GOP is making one thing clear at this week’s convention: If they’re successful in November, they will fully embrace the Project 2025 agenda, reject the reality of the climate crisis, and ignore the majority of Americans who are demanding action. When they talk about the climate crisis, it’s only to mock those of us who are confronting it. The Republican party platform released last week calls oil “liquid gold,” and encourages more production of oil, gas, and coal. Their energy slogan is Drill, Baby, Drill! And if that wasn’t enough, Trump unveiled Ohio Senator J.D. Vance as his Vice Presidential pick. Vance would be a complete disaster for our planet. J.D Vance is one of the top recipients of oil and gas money and has a history of shilling for their interests. As a fossil fuel company shareholder, he personally benefits when oil and gas companies thrive, raking in dividends from the soaring gas prices caused by production cuts and extreme heat last summer. He is a vocal supporter of fracking. He doesn’t believe climate change is a threat. = The GOP is embracing the Project 2025 agenda, a far-right blueprint that would plunge our country and democracy into chaos. It would erase any mention of climate change across the government, dismantle critical research institutions like the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), and end federal support to help the world’s poorest countries transition to wind, solar, and other renewable energy. They want to gut our progress and thrust us back into the dark ages of fossil fuel dominance. We can’t let the GOP strip away the progress we’ve made or silence the science that proves our planet is in crisis. How Tucker Carlson took JD Vance from Trump critic to VP pick

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88983081/485791623/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjM1YWJhNmYtOWQ0My1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=_GSVmN2ISqjEU-Kb3GcArdQeF0g05GyAoKAF6iWG4rk=&emci=46509e69-9d43-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=b35aba6f-9d43-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
In case you missed it, on Monday former President Donald Trump announced his pick for VP: Ohio Senator and author JD Vance.
**Vance first came onto the political scene in 2016 by criticizing his new running mate, calling Trump a con man and “America’s Hitler.” **
Today, Vance espouses more extreme views than Trump himself. He’s invoked the racist “great replacement” theory on a Fox News appearance, suggested that women shouldn’t be allowed to leave violent marriages, and has criticized abortion bans that have exceptions in the case of rape and incest.
[**We’ll explain how Fox News and Tucker Carlson helped mold Vance into Trump’s successor in a moment, but if you’re ready to help us expose Vance and Fox News, can you chip in $20 today?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88983083/485791652/-593472309?refcode=20240716-EM-JDVance&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjM1YWJhNmYtOWQ0My1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=_GSVmN2ISqjEU-Kb3GcArdQeF0g05GyAoKAF6iWG4rk=)
In 2016, Vance was a favorite of the _New York Times_ , _CNN_ , and _MSNBC_ for his bestselling memoir _Hillbilly Elegy_ and his takes on white working-class Trump supporters. But in 2018, he started appearing on _Tucker Carlson Tonight_.
In his early appearances on the show, Vance was known for his balanced and measured analysis.
Then, as he sought Trump’s endorsement for his 2022 Ohio Senate campaign, he kept going on _Fox News_ programming, including dozens of appearances on Tucker Carlson’s then-top-rated primetime program.
Soon, Vance began to mirror Carlson’s fear-mongering and conspiracy-spreading tone.
In return, Carlson gave him a regular platform on _Fox News_ and eventually asked the former president to endorse Vance for his Senate run.
Trump did and the rest is history.
**So here’s why all this matters so much right now. **
In the wake of January 6th, Vance criticized former Vice President Mike Pence for not going along with Trump’s fraudulent fake electors scheme. **If Vance is given the chance to help Trump steal an election, he would do it. He’s already said so.**
Here at COURIER, we’re dedicated to making sure voters know who JD Vance is and why his nomination is such a threat. Our reporters work in eleven key battleground states across the country to report on the issues that matter most so we can protect our democracy at the ballot box in November.

clean_body: How Tucker Carlson took JD Vance from Trump critic to VP pick Peter, In case you missed it, on Monday former President Donald Trump announced his pick for VP: Ohio Senator and author JD Vance. Vance first came onto the political scene in 2016 by criticizing his new running mate, calling Trump a con man and “America’s Hitler.” Today, Vance espouses more extreme views than Trump himself. He’s invoked the racist “great replacement” theory on a Fox News appearance, suggested that women shouldn’t be allowed to leave violent marriages, and has criticized abortion bans that have exceptions in the case of rape and incest. = In 2016, Vance was a favorite of the New York Times , CNN , and MSNBC for his bestselling memoir Hillbilly Elegy and his takes on white working-class Trump supporters. But in 2018, he started appearing on Tucker Carlson Tonight. In his early appearances on the show, Vance was known for his balanced and measured analysis. Then, as he sought Trump’s endorsement for his 2022 Ohio Senate campaign, he kept going on Fox News programming, including dozens of appearances on Tucker Carlson’s then-top-rated primetime program. Soon, Vance began to mirror Carlson’s fear-mongering and conspiracy-spreading tone. In return, Carlson gave him a regular platform on Fox News and eventually asked the former president to endorse Vance for his Senate run. Trump did and the rest is history. So here’s why all this matters so much right now. In the wake of January 6th, Vance criticized former Vice President Mike Pence for not going along with Trump’s fraudulent fake electors scheme. If Vance is given the chance to help Trump steal an election, he would do it. He’s already said so. Here at COURIER, we’re dedicated to making sure voters know who JD Vance is and why his nomination is such a threat. ---
Peter,

Earlier this month, Republicans published a 900-plus page document known as Project 2025. This document is, as its ultraconservative authors put it, "a unique opportunity for conservatives to ... build a better country for all Americans in 2025." In other words, it's a blueprint for the GOP's policy agenda if Trump wins the White House this November.

And let's be crystal-clear, Peter. _This 19-plank agenda is as radical as it comes_.

Project 2025 would drastically expand the powers of the president and destroy the ability for the judicial or legislative branches to check abuses of power. And here are just a few ways they'd use that unchecked power: Government monitoring of pregnant individuals. Prosecuting those traveling out of state for a abortion care. Enforcing a "biblically based... definition of marriage and families." And so, so much more.

**This is your chance to speak out against this anti-choice, anti-democratic, and downright draconian playbook by letting us know: Which portion of the Project 2025 platform are you most concerned by, Peter? Take our short survey now:**

Last night, like many of you, I watched the RNC. It was exhilarating and the energy was palpable. It was great to see Connecticut RNC Committeewoman Leora Levy represent Connecticut. Leora gave a moving prayer for America, the peace of Jerusalem and prayers for freedom for the Israeli Hostages. She also prayed for Corey Comperatore and his family along with the victims of the attempted assassination at President Trump's campaign rally in Butler, Pennsylvania. You can hear a portion of that prayer [here](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/1d2fd6c2-e449-4bb3-b645-109fee04a83c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/1d2fd6c2-e449-4bb3-b645-109fee04a83c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
(Patrick T. Fallon / AFP/via Getty Images)
[Pledge your support](https://substack.._bZgbGJnLGmh86ek9PUU-N6VzpLjXKz6zVaUVRaEbz4?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=146675352)
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1454853&post_id=146675352&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ2Njc1MzUyLCJpYXQiOjE3MjExNTQwMjgsImV4cCI6MTcyMzc0NjAyOCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTE0NTQ4NTMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.ghsz-3fF0Qp7trZLgHf3z_lwWtB6IDYwuy1mV-leCIs)
Leora Levy is a Cuban jew who fled communism. Her story is like so many refugees coming to America for a better life to escape the communism.
What was great about the speeches last night was the showcase of Every Day Americans, including one woman, Linda Fornos, who left Nicaragua 16 years ago for Las Vegas.
Linda voted for Biden in 2020 and in 2022 she lost her home to a devastating fire. She expressed the struggle under Biden, with one son working 3 jobs, another working 2 jobs and her full time job just to make ends meet. **6 jobs for 3 people is just too much. Inflation is one of the largest drivers causing real pocketbook pain for All Americans.**
_**Linda**_****_**expressed disgust for the border crisis and the struggle of legal immigrants that are hurt the most by illegal immigration**_**.** She expressed the failure of education and a curriculum that no longer focuses on reading, writing and math. I have also written about how the Democrats are failing our children, especially in the cities in the article - [Your Child Your Choice](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/568f9846-6c5b-4809-b77d-ebfe6ce602b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Linda, like so many other Latinos, is voting for Republicans this November because "Life was different under President Trump... we prospered" \- **She urged her "Beloved Latinos to Wake Up and Smell the Cafecito."** She further expressed that her vote has been taken for granted and will not be taken for granted under Trump. You can watch her speech [here](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/da06f9a0-a903-4e9e-ac2f-dfa262f3112a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/da06f9a0-a903-4e9e-ac2f-dfa262f3112a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**My Own Experience that the Latino Tide is Turning In Connecticut was solidified when** **we marched in the Puerto Rican Day Parade in Bridgeport.** It was a wonderful experience to celebrate Puerto Rican heritage, community, culture and music. We had a blast and we were one of a handful of Republican politicians or candidates that marched. The other was Shelton Mayor Mark Lauretti.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/1f4369e5-5197-4b8b-8c42-2d3728dcaf8b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**We experienced so much support and love from the Puerto Rican Community**. There was also representation of Dominicans and other Latinos that marched in this parade and we saw flags from many Caribbean countries represented as well.
We interacted with voters many of them who are moving to the Republican platform because of the issues that Linda spoke about: **Affordable gas, groceries, rent, healthcare access and education.**
**Latinos do not want to be taken for granted at the expense of illegal immigrants.** Unfortunately, this is the focus of the democrats to ignore legal immigrants and sacrifice them for the illegal immigrants by giving them all of these benefits, housing, education and more.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6e75ec28-1724-4792-b415-5045f70427fe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
While many of those we spoke with are democrats or unaffiliates that have voted democrat, they are coming our way and we are grateful for the messages of support. **They also asked how they could help our campaign and volunteer.**
**With changes like this, we can defeat Himes, a man who has expressed a great respect for the Sandinistas from Nicaragua**.[ See my article on that.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/739954aa-0088-48ea-8c1e-baec4cefdbea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) I have no such respect for communism.
**This campaign is all about Taking it to the People and Taking it to the Streets. At the end of this it is all about the people and not about parties, and I am the candidate of the people.**
[](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/0063bc85-2dfd-47ef-b3e8-5fb69e2c1490?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**This is why it is more important to make your voices heard at the ballot box this November and this August at the Primary. There are no excuses.** This is your fight to save our democracy and our country and **the time is NOW**.
Help me get through this primary so we can get to the people and retire Jim.
**MAKE YOUR VOICES HEARD ON AUGUST 13th BY GOING TO THE POLLS.**
Sharing is Caring - so if you like the message please pass it on.
Thank you for your continued support.
Dr. Michael Goldstein

body:

# July 23rd in San Mateo
---
|
---
| **[](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=c8af4d0117&e=c0babbc643)**

Please [join us](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=566a8fc36e&e=c0babbc643) to learn how pets play a role in improving physical and mental well-being for kids, families and older adults at a special event my office is holding in partnership with the Peninsula Humane Society 4 p.m. to 6 p.m., Tuesday, July 23, 12 Airport Blvd., San Mateo. According to famed UK veterinarian _Dr. Marc Abraham OBE: “The_ _ _ inability to leave the house is a common symptom of loneliness, so having to walk a dog once or twice daily encourages outside physical fitness, lowers rates of obesity and increases the frequency and likelihood of real life human-human interactions.” At our [PHS event](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=953d1eecc8&e=c0babbc643), you will learn how you can adopt your forever furry friend including dogs, cats, small animals and even exotic animals such as lizards, snakes and turtles [https://phs-spca.org/adopt/exotic-animals/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=d1593db77c&e=c0babbc643). This event launches the first of many in my office’s “Loneliness t o Light Series.” Abraham continues on the Campaign to End Loneliness blog: “Indeed, having a dog by your side is often the ultimate conversation starter, igniting connections, thus reducing feelings of social isolation. Staying home with a cat, rabbit, or any other furry or feathered friend also offers a degree of companionship and interaction, including fulfilling daily routines, which can all help support and manage long-term mental health issues such as depression, anxiety and loneliness.” [https://www.campaigntoendloneliness.org/the-importance-of-animals-tackling-loneliness-one-pet-at-a-time/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=0b7ded813e&e=c0babbc643) [_**RSVP HERE!**_](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=d69ebd0a31&e=c0babbc643)

## Project 2025 Attacks Abortion Access
Let me be clear right off the bat. Denying women reproductive health access is ineffective, cruel, and deadly. Every study ever conducted on abortion shows that abortion bans do not work. They do not decrease abortion rates. They only increase infant mortality rates and [maternal mortality rates by 24% or more](https://substack.com/redirect/07889e49-2d3e-4347-906e-f8d722d5226b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Since Roe was overturned, states that banned abortion have suffered a [16% increase in infant mortality](https://substack.com/redirect/07889e49-2d3e-4347-906e-f8d722d5226b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Reproductive health access is fundamentally about whether or not we trust women? Those who trust women know that women, their physicians, and their loved ones are best suited to make these private, intimate, personal healthcare decisions. Those who do not trust women want a right wing fascist government to force their one-size-fits-all view on millions of women, and thus ban abortion access.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0a50eba8-48c4-491e-8df9-edf8576d4d7b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
If Project 2025's dystopian bans on abortion are implemented, our nation will suffer massive spikes in infant and maternal mortality. Let's dive into the P25 attacks on abortion access and debunk the claims it makes to justify its backwards policies.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..yJ3B5yHmWlaQtvLzvKviMAkFIo15G8kdADt93OxUAA8?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=146635911)
## P25 Mentions Abortion At Least 200 Times
The phrases "abortion," "reproductive health," and "reproductive rights" are referenced at least 210 times in the P25 manifesto. The P25 Forward sets the tone for how degradingly it treats abortion, stating:
> The next conservative President must make the institutions of American civil society hard targets for woke culture warriors. This starts with deleting the terms ...**abortion, reproductive health, reproductive rights** , and any other term used to deprive Americans of their First Amendment rights out of every federal rule, agency regulation, contract, grant, regulation, and piece of legislation that exists.
MAGAs profess to stand for First Amendment rights while championing a punitive government ban on words they don't like. And it quickly goes downhill from here. For as much as MAGA extremists claim abortion is about "state's rights" (an absurd position in and of itself), it's a position they clearly do not believe as the P25 manifesto makes clear the goal is a national abortion ban.
## P25 Bans Abortion Contrary to Basic Science
P25 addresses abortion in every aspect of our lives, and details every conceivable measure to restrict access--all in contravention to basic scientific facts. On Page 6, P25 fascists immediately promise to "protect family life" by "_deploying existing federal powers to protect innocent life and vigorously complying with statutory bans on the federal funding of abortion_ ," and instead "_fund alternatives to abortion like adoption_." In doing so the manifesto completely ignores the fact that banning abortion results in increase maternal and infant mortality, and hence actively destroys family life. And while I can't dive into it for the sake of brevity, there are a [host of problems with the right wing push to advance adoption](https://substack.com/redirect/61ae51b2-b690-4a3c-9cc7-04e07c4ade79?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as a replacement to abortion.
Likewise on Page 62, P25 fascists demand the next Conservative President ban comprehensive sex education for young people:
> The President should immediately revoke Executive Order 1402041...related to the establishment or promotion of the Gender Policy Council and its subsidiary issues. Abolishing the Gender Policy Council would eliminate central promotion of abortion ("health services"); comprehensive sexuality education ("education")...

> The continued high rate of maternal and infant mortality is a persistent global tragedy. Contrary to current publicity, this problem is not solved by abortion.

> Every available tool, including the cutting of funds, to ensure that every state reports exactly how many abortions take place within its borders, at what gestational age of the child, for what reason, the mother's state of residence, and by what method. And to top it off, any state that does not comply with P25's reckless and dangerous violation of health privacy would lose federal Medicaid funding, per the proposed _Ensuring Accurate and Complete Abortion Data Reporting Act of 2023_. Hi Friend,
At first glance, Donald Trump's pick for vice president--Ohio Senator J.D. Vance--and my opponent, Texas Representative John Carter, might seem to have little in common.
J.D. Vance is a millennial, a first-time elected official, and a junior by any account. John Carter is on the other end of the spectrum--an octogenarian and 11-time incumbent, and a stalwart of the Republican vanguard in Congress.
But looks can be deceiving...
These two men are cut from the same cloth, and both are a danger to our republic.

* J.D. Vance has called for a nationwide abortion ban with no exceptions. John Carter co-sponsored the bill to do exactly that.

* J.D. Vance wants to gut Social Security and Medicare. John Carter has voted to do so.

* J.D. Vance says that he wouldn't have certified the 2020 presidential election on January 6. John Carter voted against certification.

J.D. Vance and my opponent, John Carter, are in lockstep with Donald Trump. None of these men should hold federal office next year.
I'm doing everything I can to unseat John Carter in November. Frankly though, I need your help: [Anything you can contribute now to help me will go a long way in countering the millions Carter has raised from D.C. lobbyists and defense contractors.](https://ckzq96gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=00163HSoKyzF0j-fB_1ZP2bL4_po-4HjvbFXeIr8Q_RZeqgJcKCyUb49vwGgKH-AJY0oJTmQ-Z4SZUNpGA6HSI1-mmFT4sgK09bbi_LD5yAs-5UAhodKkv9cwr3eWnDG7yvIdm1_wCXk2unhOHfbTxsmCTvjPWYzWzplzzWIUaWX6ME-650wFO-BklSkyhQTOazfCXB7kbkrz4sOzThCM2SqA==&c=dhwvpAIoapW4kYWCy6gTAD4DxZjTVMGFBA1C-R-pNk_aX9lowUd32A==&ch=GxYgm9zfcI8DqOf3xjj61zZ0gnDnO7xSYTdqbB5iztRrC_ph2irXhw==)

# Stop the Extremist Agenda
---
| Hi Peter,
**We need your support now more than ever.** Yesterday, Donald Trump picked J.D. Vance as his vice-presidential running mate. This choice underscores the urgent threat to our fundamental rights and freedoms.
**Why This Matters:**
* **Conventional Flimflam:** Trump called for unity after a failed assassination attempt, but picking Vance as his running mate undermines that message. Vance once called Trump “America’s Hitler” and a “cynical asshole like Nixon.” He also called Trump “cultural heroin” and couldn’t stomach voting for him in 2016.

* **Extremist Views:** Vance opposes abortion exceptions for rape and incest and applauded the overturning of Roe vs. Wade. He has a 0% score on reproductive freedom and consistently votes against protecting these rights.

* **Election Denialism:** Vance reacted to a shooting at a Trump rally by blaming Biden, claiming Biden’s rhetoric led to the incident. This incendiary statement was criticized but not disqualifying in today’s political climate.

* **Dangerous Platform:** The Republican convention, starting with Trump’s call for unity, features extremist speakers like Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene, Lt. Gov. Mark Robinson, and Sen. Ron Johnson. They have promoted dangerous rhetoric and policies that threaten our democracy and social safety nets.

* **Project 2025:** Vance supports Trump’s Project 2025, which threatens to undermine voting rights, restrict free speech, and weaken democratic institutions. It aims to ban abortion nationwide, block access to abortion pills, and end emergency abortion care.

Vance’s extreme views and support for Trump’s dangerous agenda highlight the urgent need for strong Democratic leadership in the House. Patti Hewitt is committed to fighting for the rights and freedoms of Coastal Georgia’s hardworking families. **We need her in Congress to push back against these threats.** Patti Hewitt will fight for Coastal Georgia’s families and protect our rights.
**Here’s how you can help:**
**Volunteer:** [Join our team and spread the word.](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=deab5644e5&e=0f456155ff)**Spread the Word:** Follow us on social media and tell your friends and family to follow us too.
**Donate:** [Every dollar helps us combat these extreme policies. Can you chip in $10, $25, or $50?](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=e41a8e47ba&e=0f456155ff)
**Time is Running Out.** We must act now. **Stand with Patti Hewitt to secure a safer, fairer, and healthier future for Coastal Georgia.**
Thank you for your urgent support!

name: David Hogg, Leaders We Deserve
subject: This past weekend…
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
I want to make it abundantly clear: No form of political violence is acceptable.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240716&t=1&akid=948%2E587540%2EMEzrUC)
Peter,
**This weekend, former President Trump was attacked at one of his rallies in Pennsylvania. I want to make it abundantly clear: NO form of political violence is acceptable. Ever.**
I hope former President Trump, the members of his detail and rally crowd make a speedy recovery and join the country in mourning the lives lost due to gun violence.
What happened in Butler is not okay and what happens every day to kids who aren’t the president and don’t survive isn’t either. It’s insane that we have such a major problem with gun violence in America that no one – **_not even_ a presidential candidate** – **is safe.**
Easy access to firearms is a threat to our democracy – not only as threats to those running for office, but to our democratic norms that would be violated by retaliatory violence. We need to end gun violence.
We’ve seen gun violence claim lives in Parkland with a cop assigned to our campus, in Uvalde with hundreds of police, and now at the former President’s rally with Secret Service protection. It should be crystal clear that we have failed in passing policy to prevent shootings like this from happening.
There’s no conspiracy. The fact of the matter is that it’s way too easy to access firearms in the United States and no one is safe. Not kids. Not teachers. Not parents. Not even a former President.
We must do better.
Leaders We Deserve is about giving people an opportunity to peacefully participate in our democracy, by supporting young candidates who'll be the next generation of policymakers, thinkers, and problem-solvers. When you volunteer or donate to orgs like LWD, you are making your voice heard in a way that keeps democracy alive and repudiates violence as a form of political protest.
We hope you will join us in our mission to see a better future for generations to come. It’s on us to do better. Hopefully one day events like this weekend and stories about shootings we see everyday about gun violence will be left in our history books and not our headlines. Thank you for helping to make that possible through your support of Leaders We Deserve.
**David Hogg**
Leaders We Deserve

name: Carmen Goers
subject: Celebrate National Blueberry Month - Support Our Campaign
body:
Join the Team

| | | | | | | |
---
| | | |
---
| | | **Celebrate National Blueberry Month - Support Our Campaign****!**
---

Dear Peter,
Happy National Blueberry Month! This July, we celebrate one of Washington's most beloved fruits and recognize the hardworking farmers who cultivate them. Blueberries are a symbol of our district’s rich agricultural heritage and the dedication of those who ensure we enjoy fresh, nutritious produce year-round.

Our campaign is committed to supporting the agricultural community that is the backbone of our economy. We advocate for policies that protect family farms, reduce regulatory burdens, and promote sustainable farming practices. By doing so, we ensure that our farmers can continue to thrive and provide us with the bountiful harvests we cherish.

---
| | | |
---
|
We need your support to keep this momentum going. Your donation will help us reach more voters, spread our message, and fight for the values that sustain our community.
Whether it’s $20, $50, or any amount, your contribution makes a significant impact.

---

Thank you for your continued support and dedication!

Sincerely,

Team Goers

name: Katie Porter
subject: halfway through July
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Truth to Power PAC
body:
Months before voters cast their ballots, we must support our candidates’ critical early organizing efforts.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=38986%2E3422442%2EnQ07Ip)
Derek,
Congress wasn't built for people like me. When I first got to Washington, I was the only single mom of school-age kids serving. There were groups like the Bourbon Caucus and the Beer Caucus—but not a caucus focused on lowering the cost of higher education.
And while at times that is frustrating, I didn’t come to Washington to play by the rules. I came to Washington to shake things up, and that’s what I’ve been able to do thanks to the support of Porter Supporters like you.
With my whiteboard in tow, we’ve not only called out skyrocketing CEO pay and brought life to Congressional hearings, but also passed new laws to lower drug costs, raise rates on polluters, and strengthen our economy. The whiteboard is a tool to bridge ideological divides, get everyone on the same page with a shared set of facts, and invite people into conversations with some of the most powerful people in America about the challenges families face.
Now, I need your help to elect a new wave of candidates who will carry on my work in Washington.
Today marks the halfway point of July. And although Election Day might still seem far away, the truth is that November’s critical races aren’t going to be decided in November. Or October. Or even September.
They’re going to be decided right now. Long before Election Day, early organizing, fundraising, outreach, and voter registration efforts will determine whether or not our candidates prevail this fall.
All of those efforts cost money. So as we pass the midpoint of July and enter the critical organizing period that will make or break races across the country, can you chip in to ensure that we have the resources to support our endorsed candidates?
You can use this personal link to make a contribution: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240716?personal=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240716?personal=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=em20240716-38986-&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38986_3422442_nQ07Ip&akid=38986%2E3422442%2EnQ07Ip)**
Thanks so much,
Katie Porter

**Katie Porter started Truth to Power to support Democrats who reject corporate PAC money** and are running to protect the environment, restore the nationwide right to an abortion, and create an economy that works for working people. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/truth-to-power-1?refcode=em20240716-38986&amounts=&t=2&refcode2=38986_3422442_nQ07Ip&akid=38986%2E3422442%2EnQ07Ip)**

body:
This is long but important. I hope you’ll take the time to read it.
#
Peter — after all the second quarter fundraising reports were filed with the Federal Election Commission yesterday, we learned that our grassroots movement to elect Lucas Kunce outraised Josh Hawley’s campaign AGAIN. By a lot.
In a moment, I’m going to explain exactly what this means for our U.S. Senate race here in Missouri. **But first I have to ask,[will you help keep this momentum going by chipping in your very first donation today?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/58310?refcode=em20240716-6013&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6013%2E614464%2EnKTILE)**
**[Elect Lucas Kunce »](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/58310?refcode=em20240716-6013&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=6013%2E614464%2EnKTILE)**
**These reports marked the end of another record-breaking quarter — and not just for fundraising.** Lucas raised the most ever for a Missouri Senate challenger in Q2 of an election year, with support from real people in all 114 Missouri counties and the City of St. Louis. He also earned major endorsements from UAW, VoteVets, AFSCME, and Abortion Action Missouri.
At every stop on the campaign trail, from town halls and labor meetings to the people he meets along parade routes in every corner of Missouri, working people have turned out in huge crowds to support Lucas and this unparalleled grassroots movement we’ve built together. They’re fired up to defeat Josh Hawley this year.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/58310?refcode=em20240716-6013&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=6013%2E614464%2EnKTILE)
**[Elect Lucas Kunce »](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/58310?refcode=em20240716-6013&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=6013%2E614464%2EnKTILE)**
Lucas’ message of taking back power for everyday people is already resonating with voters of all parties, all across the state. _That’s why, even before starting paid communications, a recent poll showed Lucas gaining on Hawley — even winning by 5% among independents while Hawley lags 10% behind Trump._
**Unlike other GOP-held U.S. Senate seats we’re fighting for this year, Missouri has a real record of split-ticket voters.**
In Jason Kander’s race, Missouri’s last U.S. Senate race during a presidential election, hundreds of thousands of Kander-Trump voters helped him close the gap from a 14% deficit to a near victory against popular incumbent Senator Roy Blunt. Kander outperformed the presidential ticket by nearly 16%.
And don’t forget about Todd Akin, whose anti-abortion extremism resulted in his double-digit lead swinging to a massive win for Democrats — who outperformed the presidential race by 25% that year.
**Jason Kander himself wrote that not only is Hawley vulnerable this year — but that Lucas Kunce can beat him. And even Donald Trump agreed. **
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/58310?refcode=em20240716-6013&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=6013%2E614464%2EnKTILE)
**[Defeat Josh Hawley »](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/58310?refcode=em20240716-6013&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=6013%2E614464%2EnKTILE)**
Hawley won his first U.S. Senate race with only 51% of the vote — and he underperformed Trump’s margin in the previous presidential cycle by 13%.
**Any loss of support for Hawley will jeopardize his chances of being re-elected. After all, he’s already the least popular GOP Senator up for re-election this year.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/58310?refcode=em20240716-6013&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=7&akid=6013%2E614464%2EnKTILE)
**[Defeat Josh Hawley »](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/58310?refcode=em20240716-6013&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=8&akid=6013%2E614464%2EnKTILE)**
**Now, in Hawley’s first election since the Dobbs decision, he’ll share a ballot with a massively energizing initiative to end Missouri’s total abortion ban (which Hawley supports) and restore reproductive freedoms (which Hawley helped end).**
Reproductive rights — from abortion to birth control to IVF — are motivating voters more than ever. We’ve seen it just over the last few years in red and purple states like Kansas, Ohio, Kentucky, and Alabama, where voters have overwhelmingly supported similar measures to enshrine abortion rights and rejected anti-reproductive freedom candidates at the ballot box.
But here in Missouri, we’ve got Josh Hawley. He’s built a whole career — even a family business — on banning the whole spectrum of reproductive rights. And in the past six years, he’s made a terrifying amount of progress in that mission.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/58310?refcode=em20240716-6013&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=9&akid=6013%2E614464%2EnKTILE)
**[Defeat Josh Hawley »](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/58310?refcode=em20240716-6013&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&akid=6013%2E614464%2EnKTILE)**
_Hawley believes his mission to outlaw all abortions is just as important and brave as the efforts by American abolitionists to end slavery._ So while other GOP candidates have made attempts to moderate their positions, Hawley has made it clear he won’t be doing the same.
**Hawley even publicly rebuked the GOP platform, and proudly declared himself to be an extremist well outside the norm of mainstream Republican voters.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/58310?refcode=em20240716-6013&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=11&akid=6013%2E614464%2EnKTILE)
**[Defeat Josh Hawley »](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/58310?refcode=em20240716-6013&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=12&akid=6013%2E614464%2EnKTILE)**
**No U.S. Senator has a worse record on reproductive rights than Josh Hawley.**
If we have the resources to communicate Lucas’ message and the truth about Hawley’s record to voters in the weeks ahead, we can defeat Josh Hawley and take this seat back for real Missourians. It’s happened before, and we can make it happen again. But we need your help to do it, Peter.
**[So please, will you rush a donation of absolutely any amount today so we can deliver Lucas’ election-winning message to voters and flip this U.S. Senate seat on November 5th? Lucas isn’t taking a cent from corporate PACs, so we’re counting on help from real people like you to continue building this movement.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/58310?refcode=em20240716-6013&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=13&akid=6013%2E614464%2EnKTILE) **

Peter — after all the second quarter fundraising reports were filed with the Federal Election Commission yesterday, we learned that our grassroots movement to elect Lucas Kunce outraised Josh Hawley’s campaign AGAIN. By a lot. In a moment, I’m going to explain exactly what this means for our U.S. Senate race here in Missouri. Lucas raised the most ever for a Missouri Senate challenger in Q2 of an election year, with support from real people in all 114 Missouri counties and the City of St. Louis. He also earned major endorsements from UAW, VoteVets, AFSCME, and Abortion Action Missouri. At every stop on the campaign trail, from town halls and labor meetings to the people he meets along parade routes in every corner of Missouri, working people have turned out in huge crowds to support Lucas and this unparalleled grassroots movement we’ve built together. They’re fired up to defeat Josh Hawley this year. Lucas’ message of taking back power for everyday people is already resonating with voters of all parties, all across the state. That’s why, even before starting paid communications, a recent poll showed Lucas gaining on Hawley — even winning by 5% among independents while Hawley lags 10% behind Trump. Unlike other GOP-held U.S. Senate seats we’re fighting for this year, Missouri has a real record of split-ticket voters. In Jason Kander’s race, Missouri’s last U.S. Senate race during a presidential election, hundreds of thousands of Kander-Trump voters helped him close the gap from a 14% deficit to a near victory against popular incumbent Senator Roy Blunt. Kander outperformed the presidential ticket by nearly 16%. And don’t forget about Todd Akin, whose anti-abortion extremism resulted in his double-digit lead swinging to a massive win for Democrats — who outperformed the presidential race by 25% that year. Jason Kander himself wrote that not only is Hawley vulnerable this year — but that Lucas Kunce can beat him. And even Donald Trump agreed. Any loss of support for Hawley will jeopardize his chances of being re-elected. After all, he’s already the least popular GOP Senator up for re-election this year. Fellow patriot - Big news!

**Tonight, I’m taking the stage at the Republican National Convention in Milwaukee.**

We all know what’s at stake. The last four years under Joe Biden and Sherrod Brown have been a DISASTER for America. Our borders are wide open, our economy is in shambles, and our national security is a joke.

name: State Representative Ryan Chamberlin
subject: Weekly Update from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/official-newsletter-12701301?e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| |
---
| | **WEEKLY UPDATE FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN**
---
| My Fellow Floridians,

Thank you for trusting me to serve you in our state legislature! **I’ve been working tirelessly alongside my fellow conservatives and Governor Ron DeSantis to get real things done for my constituents.** Since my election, I’ve been so proud of the progress we’ve made to grow and strengthen our community, and I look forward to the work we will do in this upcoming legislative session to build on these efforts. **Today, I have some important updates and announcements to share with you.** It was great to spend another productive week out in the community, attending events, meeting constituents, and supporting fellow Florida leaders.

As always, please never hesitate to reach out to my office if you are in need of assistance. We would be more than happy to help you in any way we can. **Please contact us by clicking[here](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=b5ddcfcaf1&e=d1c1b9864f).**
---
| | **Meet Conservative Candidate Steve Shives for House District 27**
---
|
---
| **I hope you will join me and my wife, Jenny, on Monday, July 29, for an evening supporting conservative candidate for State House District 27, Steve Shives.** The campaign event will take place at our home in Belleview from 6:30 to 8 p.m.

**Steve is a regular guy who wants to get to work in Tallahassee to fight for what’s right and get our nation back on the right track.** It’s my pleasure to support him in this important race, and I look forward to serving alongside him in our state legislature. If you are able to attend, please RSVP to [contact@ryanchamberlin.com](mailto:contact@ryanchamberlin.com?subject=RSVP). **We look forward to seeing you there!**
---
| | **Wednesday, July 10 - Florida Senior Living Association 2024 Legislator of the Year**
---
|
---
| It was great to attend the **Florida Senior Living Association Award Ceremony**. I’m proud to share that I received the **2024 Legislator of the Year Award** for my work during the legislative session. My fellow House member, **Majority Leader Michael Grant** , received the prestigious lifetime award. Leader Grant’s mentorship this past session played an essential role in my growth as a legislator, which led me to achieve this incredible honor.
---
| | **Thursday, July 11 - Tour of Hands of Mercy Everywhere, Lakeside Learning Center & Campaign Event for Commissioner Matt McClain**
---
|
---
---
| I had the wonderful opportunity to tour the new addition to **Hands of Mercy Everywhere** ,******the Lakeside Learning Center**. This project has been in the works for a long time, and it was exciting to see it come to fruition. This incredible center gives young girls in need in our community the opportunity to learn, thrive, and reach their fullest potential. **Learn more by clicking[here](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=65f07148ed&e=d1c1b9864f).**
---
|
---
| Later that day, I was honored to support my good friend **Matt McClain** at a fundraising event for his campaign to continue serving on the **Marion County Commission**. Matt has been a strong and principled leader in our community, and I’m proud to stand with him in this race.
---
| | **Freedom Month Sales Tax Holiday**
---
|
---
| Throughout the month of July, Floridians can save big on summer fun during the **Freedom Month Sales Tax Holiday**. Click [here](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=cb024b5b7d&e=d1c1b9864f) to learn more about the qualifying recreation and outdoor items and admissions to entertainment and cultural events.
---
|
---
| | Thank you for electing me to serve you in our state legislature! It has been an incredible honor to serve you and help build a brighter future for **Florida** and **House District 24**. I look forward to the progress we will make for our state in the future.

May God bless you and the Free State of Florida!

Best regards,

**Ryan Chamberlin**
******State Representative**
**District 24**
---

State Representative Ryan Chamberlin

1101 The Capitol
402 South Monroe Street
Tallahassee, FL 32399-1300

subject: Speak No Evil
body:

# “Speak no Evil”
---
| (Artist: Banksy above)
_**"The good man brings good things out of the good stored up in his heart, and the evil man brings evil things out of the evil stored up in his heart. For out of the overflow of his heart his mouth speaks."**__**—Luke 6:45**_
The political establishment and mainstream media now have the opportunity and the obligation to change course and stop the escalation of threatening and dangerous political rhetoric.
Why is this a critical moment? We now understand that making threatening statements and advocating for violence against political opponents is not only irresponsible, but also dangerous.
Let's consider this behavior and its inherent dangers as the norm as of July 12th. Political parties on both sides have been guilty of inflammatory and ugly statements, but the contagion has become systemic.
On July 13th, the world changed, and we see this rhetoric for what it is; harmful, escalating divisiveness to fear, hatred and ultimately, assassinations. We cannot revert to the mindset before July 12th, or else every day will be like July 13th in this country, and the ultimate assassination will be that of our Republic.
**Key Facts:** • The downward spiral of political speech has been building a cacophony of escalating threats toward Trump and those who support his candidacy. Here is a collection of summarized words/statements from some of our highest office holders, mainstream media and Hollywood stars;
\- “Punch him in the face”\- “Domestic enemies”\- “Blow them up”\- “Assassinate”\- “Wring their neck”\- “Beat him up”\- “Put a bullet in him”\- “Where is John Wilkes Booth when you need him”\- “Take him out”\- “You will pay the price”\- “You won’t know what hit you”\- “Threat to our country”\- “He is Hitler”, and in the last few days, \- “don't miss next time."
Recently, President Biden stated that it was time to “Put Trump in the bullseye”
• Firey speech has been a part of all political endeavors even back to ancient Rome. Now, however, it is super-charged with instant, and exponentially powerful broadcast communication. Winning by vilifying your opponent is not new, but the inherent danger of invoking the use of violence has metastasized before our eyes. Those making these statements will now have to account for them, as the eyes of the nation watch. • In Lincoln's time, the press criticized him for his morals, style, and behavior. They highlighted what they called "Lincoln's smutty frontier jokes and cackling enjoyment of lowbrow humor," and also commented on his uncombed hair and tendency to throw one leg over an arm of his chair. Another newspaper called him "a vulgar tyrant" and criticized his career, personal qualities, and conversation style, referring to him as a "low buffoon" and accusing him of squandering the lives of millions without remorse. • As the Civil War ground on, with riots in many of the nation’s major northern cities, and a faltering military campaign against the Confederacy, Lincoln was called, a widow maker....orphan maker, and more. Lincoln and those that supported him were labeled as “aiders and abettors of murder”. In one state newspaper, the editor advocated that Lincoln be assassinated if he were reelected. [https://quod.lib.umich.edu/j/jala/2629860.0032.105/--lincoln-s-critics-the-copperheads?rgn=main;view=fulltext](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=c0610a3278&e=8763c56857) • On the death of Lincoln, Frederick Douglass said “He never shocked prejudices unnecessarily. Having learned Statesmanship while splitting rails, he always used the thin edge of the wedge first, and the fact that he used this at all meant that he would if need be, use the thick as well as the thin.” [https://rememberinglincoln.fords.org/node/812](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=8cf1b4ace5&e=8763c56857) **Bottom Line:** It is time for action. Statements that refer to violence and inspire fear must stop. The public, regardless of political affiliation, must reject this dangerous behavior.
For those who think "words are just words and don't pull triggers," it's important to understand that while words can't physically pull a trigger, they can certainly inspire people to act. Words have a powerful impact, especially when used by people with influence and magnified in the digital channels. Words can stir emotions and motivate people to do things, good or bad. When leaders use aggressive language, including direct statements about violence, it can sometimes lead to violent acts. This is why some people can be held legally responsible if their words encourage harmful actions. Now, this liability may increase.
Everyone, especially those in powerful positions, must now think much more carefully about the words they use.
As the world-renowned graffiti artist, political activist, and painter known as Banksy said recently, “Be a voice not an echo.” Be a voice for respectful disagreement.
_Chris Coyle, Pomfret RTC Chair_ _KCarl Smith, Renowkned Frederick Douglas Author_ _Dominic Rapini, CTGOP Candidate, Secretary of the State_

I attended for 2 years through scholarships and grants but eventually left to work after I could no longer sustain the tuition costs. I went back a few years later for one semester, but even then, I couldn’t manage working and studying full time. I got married, and had my children, but I always felt like _something was missing._ The thing is, Peter, I’m not a quitter, but I had quit school. I felt like I had let down my friends who had graduated college, and wanted to be an example for my children on how to accomplish goals – but mostly, _I had this fire within me to succeed._ So, over 25 years later, I went back to UNC and earned a bachelor’s degree in Political Science and Afro and African-American studies. name: Andrea Salinas
subject: two paths ahead of us
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Andrea Salinas for Oregon
body:
If there was any big takeaway from the first night of the Republican National Convention, it was this: _**It has never been more important that Democrats retake the House of Representatives.**_ We saw the national Republican Party rally around a Vice Presidential nominee who has explicitly campaigned on an agenda to “end abortion.” We heard promises to undo all the progress we’ve made together these last four years. We saw extremist figures like Marjorie Taylor Greene take the stage to attack and demean LGBTQ+ people. **We have the power to determine whether we go down that road — or whether we elect a pro-choice Democratic majority in Congress that treats everyone with respect, and puts real solutions before empty politics. body:
Peter –

I was deeply horrified by the recent attack on former President Trump.

I'm grateful for the quick response from law enforcement and relieved he is safe. My heart goes out to the family of Corey Comperatore, the brave firefighter who lost his life protecting his loved ones. Violence has no place in our country. We must unite against hate and show through our actions that we are better than this.

We are all still processing this weekend's attack, and as I’ve heard from many of you across our community, I know there is a lot of worry and uncertainty about the future. But this terrible event does not define who we are, Peter. We are a stronger, better country, and it's up to us to prove it through our actions. Together, we can rise to the occasion.

With the election approaching in a few months, the choices we make will significantly impact Colorado and the entire country. We will keep advocating for our principles and clearly presenting our positive vision, ensuring that voters understand our stance on key issues when they cast their ballots this fall.

Thanks,

Yadira Caraveo

The Republican National Convention is a forum for extremists to peddle the gun lobby’s dangerous “guns everywhere” agenda.
#

Friends -
Yesterday marked the first day of the Republican National Convention. By the end of the convention on Thursday, Donald Trump will officially be the Republican presidential nominee.
Donald Trump’s refusal to address our gun violence crisis makes him unfit to serve.Trump has proven time and time again that he won’t take action to save lives. He said so himself at an NRA event earlier this year, bragging to the audience that his administration “did nothing” on guns.
Trump has explicitly stated that if he wins this November, he will fire the ATF Director at noon on Inauguration Day. It’s clear he’ll get right to work rolling back President Biden’s gun safety policies.
[**We have made far too much progress in our movement towards a future free from gun violence to allow this to happen. So please: Can we count on you to rush in a $3 contribution to GIFFORDS PAC today to help us defeat Donald Trump this November?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-july24.-nTEO4&refcode=em240716-1-30&t=1&akid=8512%2E3935704%2E9y3DIu)
**[DONATE](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-july24.-nTEO4&refcode=em240716-1-30&t=2&akid=8512%2E3935704%2E9y3DIu)**
In addition to Trump becoming the official Republican presidential nominee, JD Vance will officially be the vice presidential nominee. Vance opposes background checks and called bump stocks—used to kill 60 people in Las Vegas—“fake problems.” Vance is yet another NRA lackey who can’t be trusted to tackle our gun violence crisis.
Despite media reports that the Republican National Convention would be a unifying event, it has become a forum for extremists to peddle the gun lobby’s dangerous “guns everywhere” agenda. We must be prepared to push back against the lies and conspiracies that will be thrown at our movement for gun safety.
[**Will you please make a $3 contribution to support us in defeating Donald Trump and other gun lobby-backed candidates up and down the ballot who will roll back the progress we’ve made in our fight for gun safety?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-july24.-nTEO4&refcode=em240716-1-30&t=3&akid=8512%2E3935704%2E9y3DIu)

Peter, It's summertime and folks are trying to spend as much time away from their inboxes as possible. _Us too!_ But the flip side of that is that the NDRC is now in the midst of a "summer slump" — when people understandably pay less attention to politics and stop opening emails like this one. (So first of all, thank you for opening my message!) Instead of just asking for money today, I want to lay out what work we’re doing over the summer — and how a dip in our fundraising like the one we’re seeing in July can set us back for months to come. **Right now, we’re working to ensure our movement has everything we'll need to keep****pushing ****for a stronger, fairer democracy from now until Election Day and beyond, including:**
* Rolling out endorsements of Democracy Defenders in our priority states
* Investing in on-the-ground efforts to make sure those pro-democracy leaders get elected
* Rapidly responding to anti-democratic agendas — whether it be from state legislatures or the stage at the Republican National Convention this week
* Building new mapping infrastructure as a part of our 10 Year Plan

_... and more!_ We simply can’t let the summer slump set us back. There’s too much to do and too much at stake. I hope we can count you in. More soon,
Brianna Shamsuddoha P.S. Given her track record, voters should send Franz to Congress." \- The Seattle Times This is huge news – it's incredibly rare for the Seattle Times to write an endorsement this glowing. In addition to praising Hilary's bipartisan leadership and her groundbreaking achievements on wildfire response, the Editorial Board noted that on Day One, Hilary will be one of the most knowledgeable people in Congress on environmental issues and climate change – critical leadership that we need right now. body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP03/1/67635/images/IDP%20logo.jpg]
Peter,

This weekend, our party welcomed thousands of Democrats to Indianapolis for the 2024 Indiana State Democratic Convention. The event was a massive success and at the end of the night, delegates from across the state came together and officially nominated Terry Goodin as Lieutenant Governor and Destiny Wells as Attorney General to complete our ticket with Jennifer McCormick for Governor and Valerie McCray for U.S. Senate.

We must also reflect and come together to condemn the horrendous attempt on former President Trump’s life on Saturday. Though politics can get heated, we know that political violence has no place in American life.

As Democrats, McCormick, Goodin, McCray, Wells, and the entire Indiana Democratic Party are committed to seeing our great state’s sense of dignity, integrity, and practicality restored this November. Indeed, it is for this same reason that we are committed to restoring reproductive rights, building up our labor unions, and fostering belonging in our state for everyone. Our platform is built on this simple value because not one person should be left behind in a country where we believe that liberty and justice are guaranteed to ALL. We have a positive vision for Indiana’s future that all Hoosiers deserve to hear.

We appreciate you taking the time to read, and we would like to extend a hearty congratulations to everyone who came together to complete Indiana’s Democratic ballot. INDems also wants to thank everyone who made the convention a success: There is no movement in history that did not get its start at the grassroots level, and ours is no different.

Please consider making a donation today to strengthen the future of our state and help spread our positive vision for a better Indiana to every county in our beautiful state. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/indems]

Thanks,
INDems

Indiana Democratic Party
101 W Washington St., #1110E
Indianapolis, IN 46204

I want to take a moment to remind you of my journey to the U.S. Senate, the important le ssons I have learned along the way, and why I continue to believe wholeheartedly in our beloved state.

My father, a World War II veteran, left school during the Great Depression to join the Army. Though he only had a ninth grade education, he built a career as a hard-working cement finisher. My mother, a dedicated voter who never missed an election, instilled in me the importance of civic duty.

From my parents, I inherited an unwavering love for this country that I have proudly carried throughout my life. It's something I strive to keep alive in Wyoming.

Later, in medical school, I learned the importance of having a plan before taking action, a lesson that has proven invaluable in both my medical career and my service as your senator. Just as in surgery, effective leadership requires a clear vision and a strategic approach to problem-solving.

As you may know, I am sometimes referred to as _"Wyoming's doctor,"_ but to be honest, that is what I have always strived to be as your senator. I have wholeheartedly dedicated myself to serving the state, addressing its challenges, and making it the best it can be.

**_Whether it's advocating for our veterans, championing American energy security, or safeguarding our borders, I've always strived to be a voice for all Wyoming people. Your concerns are my concerns, and your aspirations are my aspirations._**

As we look towards the future, I'm confident that Wyoming has the potential to be an even stronger, more prosperous state. **[But it will require strong leadership, a clear vision, and your continued support.](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=52b3f6229a684c38bfb16887b7ad444f&_e=vHcy-rAgve-3QG0Pcb_T_QMw3IGPaMMvXP8zfIhjBL7_cs3_v7VGFXqzRqUAiRfPcRWDTUM_rtgl1Eu3SendZtg-SkKwTls51wRdrGA8Ggh6qDqgqxALMDv1TFB8-iiyW3TzsbXSLbdkCjD4IV1RZh1OgzV59msOCR791P9_doC5mmTgtKwRBsgBH3aAKTPz0JaYUCKeGQwZES9ESG4UblBL43Z9PgoN8rTkjzChV5OvyRQiJTZgw0FRtBbY0X97XcSo7CFS4GK5wpIjaOxPlxgtctTKY_sFac9lPP93oSE%3D)**

Already, your support has been instrumental in my journey, and I promise to continue fighting for the issues that matter most to Wyoming families.

Sincerely,
Senator John Barrasso [CHIP IN FOR A STRONG WYOMING](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=52b3f6229a684c38bfb16887b7ad444f&_e=vHcy-rAgve-3QG0Pcb_T_QMw3IGPaMMvXP8zfIhjBL7_cs3_v7VGFXqzRqUAiRfPcRWDTUM_rtgl1Eu3SendZtg-SkKwTls51wRdrGA8Ggh6qDqgqxALMDv1TFB8-iiym48f1-86e8E0WBN0J7AmI90K5J3Rbb75_DNz3HJF7zoisqbWbMUVek6cRFu0DcWMUq87mcqnvAjGsCiaOMjpv03N530-qJPNTYNXh-o1VvkUmtfw0AJhTfKnaD4oeG8wEr_vHONSiIQQ3OABD4wwiEIOROowM1F2p7XSnhXhCjI%3D)

name: Ro Khanna
subject: The Supreme Court obliterated 40 years of precedent. This is how Congress can make it right.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ro for Congress
body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

Last month, the Supreme Court overturned Chevron deference, the foundation of modern administrative law. It guides courts to defer to the expertise of federal agencies when dealing with ambiguities in the specifics of regulations. For example, judges, not experts, may now be forced to handle technical questions [https://www.nrdc.org/stories/what-happens-if-supreme-court-ends-chevron-deference] about equipment use or complex questions [https://www.nrdc.org/stories/what-happens-if-supreme-court-ends-chevron-deference] about how weather patterns impact downwind air pollution.

In throwing it out, they obliterated 40 years of precedent and upended our entire system of reasonable regulatory checks on corporate power.

60% of regulations [https://www.arnoldporter.com/en/perspectives/advisories/2024/07/when-apa-claims-accrue-under-corner-post] – including those protecting the environment, worker’s rights, and public health – rely on Chevron deference. Each and every one, no matter how long-standing, could now be under attack.

Tell Congress: Protect common-sense regulations. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/chevron-doctrine-petition?contactdata=/j23NO15MNYdkn5+5t1UJcpwyw1aUDntTysrHPduSGfxlwn4HfX5RFYDcGMwUdIuRBMQABu7/fx+t4m4qpf59rAWgXZA2E16DWnia+MZUGzqiCq+eix39VXaTwXR1njzFRWfTVP8Esmt17+zR8AnNw==]

https://twitter.com/RoKhanna/status/1806732783009571143 [https://twitter.com/RoKhanna/status/1806732783009571143]

The far-right Supreme Court is sabotaging the public interest. As Justice Kagan remarked [https://www.supremecourt.gov/opinions/23pdf/22-451_7m58.pdf] , “the majority turns itself into the country’s administrative czar," giving unaccountable judges an effective veto [https://slate.com/news-and-politics/2024/06/elena-kagan-dissent-supreme-court-john-roberts-chevron-disaster.html] over experts.

TAKE ACTION: Tell Congress to codify the Chevron doctrine and protect public interest over unchecked greed. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/chevron-doctrine-petition?contactdata=/j23NO15MNYdkn5+5t1UJcpwyw1aUDntTysrHPduSGfxlwn4HfX5RFYDcGMwUdIuRBMQABu7/fx+t4m4qpf59rAWgXZA2E16DWnia+MZUGzqiCq+eix39VXaTwXR1njzFRWfTVP8Esmt17+zR8AnNw==]

Thank you for your activism and all that you do.

In solidarity,
Ro

clean_body: [] Friend, Last month, the Supreme Court overturned Chevron deference, the foundation of modern administrative law. It guides courts to defer to the expertise of federal agencies when dealing with ambiguities in the specifics of regulations. For example, judges, not experts, may now be forced to handle technical questions [] about equipment use or complex questions [] about how weather patterns impact downwind air pollution. In throwing it out, they obliterated 40 years of precedent and upended our entire system of reasonable regulatory checks on corporate power. 60% of regulations [] – including those protecting the environment, worker’s rights, and public health – rely on Chevron deference. Each and every one, no matter how long-standing, could now be under attack. Tell Congress: Protect common-sense regulations. [==] [] The far-right Supreme Court is sabotaging the public interest. As Justice Kagan remarked [] , “the majority turns itself into the country’s administrative czar," giving unaccountable judges an effective veto [] over experts. TAKE ACTION: Tell Congress to codify the Chevron doctrine and protect public interest over unchecked greed. [==] Sign the Petition [==] Thank you for your activism and all that you do. In solidarity, Ro Wait! One more thing– Ro doesn't accept a cent from lobbyists or PACs, meaning our work is completely funded by grassroots supporters like you.
