Trump allies have made no secret about their plan to use Project 2025 — a far-right manifesto containing harmful policies — to roll back our freedoms and radically remake our country. His running mate, JD Vance, is closely connected to the Heritage Foundation, the organization leading on Project 2025. Trump’s campaign isn’t built on ideas to improve Americans’ lives, but on vicious disinformation, voter suppression, and an election sabotage scheme designed to help him regain power. And the RNC, which he handpicked, is following his lead. = For months now, the RNC has been not-so-secretly making moves to recruit 100,000 volunteers and attorneys to monitor the vote as “election integrity” watchdogs. What that really means is they’re recruiting people to engage in poll watching and voter intimidation. They're working with local election officials to slow down and block efforts to certify election results, and they're preparing to challenge thousands of Georgians' right to vote — all while continuing to spread lies and disinformation about the outcome of the 2020 election. Record turnout in 2020 renewed the RNC’s insidious efforts to make voting more difficult. They’re ramping up their efforts to target Black, brown, young, unhoused, and other marginalized voters — but we won’t back down. body:

Let's go win!
I just visited one of our many postcard-writing groups in Marquette. They're reaching hundreds of voters, galvanized at a local coffee shop every week, hunkering down, focused, and delivering our positive message.
It's groups like this that motivate me to keep up the fight.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julyad [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julyad]
We have just 21 days until the primary election, and although things look great, we cannot take anything for granted. We are working tirelessly to earn your primary vote and fuel our efforts toward November.
We have some critical goals to hit this month to fund our outreach. Any way you can pitch in— moral support, volunteering, or financially— [linktr.ee/boblorinser] will help propel us to victory this August and November.
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julyad]
Friends,
Every day, we rise before dawn next to the lakes we're duty-bound to protect. We are more energized than yesterday to fight for hardworking families of the most significant Congressional district in America. To keep going, we need more resources.
Friends, I truly hate asking for money.
To give it to you straight, I do not believe this should be such a big part of the democratic process.
It's why I am the only candidate in the race who has committed to campaign finance reform and pledged that we would be grassroots-funded — no corporate PACs, no dark money, no ultra-wealthy donors looking for political influence. It's just us, people like you, pitching in what they can when they can.
But the other truth is that to continue our fight, we must get in front of every voter these last 20 days. Your contributions benefit our last leg of outreach: texting, phone banking, postcards, mailers, neighborhood canvasses, TV ads, and my incredible staff.
To keep up our momentum, I'm asking for $5, $10, or $25 to fuel the fight. With you in my corner, I won't stop this tireless effort. You deserve a Congressman with tenacity, grit, and perseverance, and I'm eager to deliver with vigor.
I am endlessly grateful for your contributions. Your support means the world to me and our campaign. Every penny is making a difference. Thank you.
Let's win an election!
-Dr. Bob
Bob Lorinser
Candidate for US Congress
Northern Michigan / Upper Peninsula

Derek, I have
some concerning news in my Senate race:

My MAGA Republican opponent Steve Garvey outraised our campaign last
quarter — by over $1 million.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=july2024_abs_em.oAIbuh&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20240716_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=7079%2E5257348%2EW4GWdx ]We need to make up this gap in fundraising right away and make sure he
doesn’t outraise us again. Derek,
can you help us catch up by rushing in a
contribution today?

This is the outcome we feared,
Derek:

Steve Garvey, jumping on Donald Trump’s fundraising momentum this summer,
comes out in support of the former president and fundraises off the Trump
trial.

GOP super PACs, willing to spend big to create a red wave this November,
start cutting big checks.

MAGA leaders, wanting to see me defeated, point to Steve Garvey and
California as a new opportunity to flip (and to pitch in contributions).

Meanwhile, we must ensure that Democrats up and down the ballot in

Friend, My heart goes out to all the families of those who were injured and killed in the mass shooting at the campaign rally in Pennsylvania this past weekend. Sadly, far too many of us have experienced this kind of violence and loss. Gun violence is an epidemic touching every community, and my district has seen multiple mass shootings recently. At a recent gun violence prevention rally in my district, we demanded common-sense gun reforms to create a safer future for everyone. No matter your political affiliation or beliefs, we all deserve to be safe in our communities, at school, our places of worship, and with our families. As school shooting survivor David Hogg wrote: _“it’s way too easy to access firearms in the United States and no one is safe. Not kids. Not teachers. Not parents. Not even a former President.”_ The person who killed David’s classmates used an AR-15 rifle, the assault weapon of choice for many of our country’s deadliest mass shootings. This same assault weapon was used in this weekend’s assassination attempt. Since our country’s assault weapons ban expired 20 years ago, mass shootings have drastically increased. **These weapons of war have no place in our communities.** There is no reason to use a weapon that can fire up to 60 rounds per minute and tear bodies apart. **Last year U.S. gun sales hit a record high, and gun violence is now the leading cause of death for children and teens in our country. I refuse to accept this as normal.** But the far-right majority on the Supreme Court just overturned a ban on bump stocks, legalizing these dangerous tools that make semi-automatic guns like AR-15s more like machine guns to kill even more people more quickly. Congress must pass legislation in order to ban bump stocks for good. **With financial stakes in gun companies and donations from the gun lobby, many Republican members of Congress continue to block common-sense gun reforms.** They’ve also worn pins in the shape of AR-15 rifles, disrespecting people who’ve been impacted by gun violence. I’m demanding that Congress listen to the majority of Americans, who are in favor of stricter gun laws such as banning AR-15s and other assault weapons. body:

|

Fellow American,

I just walked off the stage at the Republican National Convention and wanted to follow up with you immediately. If there's one thing I wanted you to take away from my speech, it's that **America is worth fighting for. This is no time for wimpy Republicans. Americans want a President who is proud of their country and who they can be proud of. And that President is Donald Trump.**

Joe Biden is an embarrassment. We went from the strongest president of my lifetime to the weakest in history. As an Afghanistan veteran, I've never been more ashamed than when Joe Biden's disastrous withdrawal left 13 American heroes dead, and then he lied about it.

[**But, America is worth fighting for.**](http://links.banksforsenate.com/u/click?_t=588630feb05642bf856633600a62821b&_m=e167134957644e50b32dba83d2abb049&_e=x1JPudrC9dC70GnYLqmperd-XPwpd5lWiSZo9X7zVDItdKxw-36RlebtyYIQkJyxnErErW2u2rFli5HvGsfrkiwi-es7AqcggWmkp-KNtL8e59XdWmO6maIb26ZXjGfYqCgApfGumeUhUwGQyvBp_3JQcDGpJ_muXrUOgcM1S-x8FMg6ELAac9TPyo15Qgva7J7N7B_yNCOIorE7YHYl-TUNZ7Pk1bEH5nCVuAcrXMGLkJPu9-5USQvifY7s6iJJBhK5O8m3XsP-nDP8jhOHeggSlpknIVhGlWG3RncwLRfq8aEpzeNq96WydanQ3qpU)
I grew up with the American Dream, picking myself up from my own bootstraps and creating my own journey in life. I pursued life, liberty, and happiness. Now, I'm pursuing the chance for our children to live that same American Dream.

Republicans are fighting for a better future for the working class. [**I 'm humbly asking you to send my campaign a donation of whatever you can afford so that I can continue to fight for you in the Senate.**](http://links.banksforsenate.com/u/click?_t=588630feb05642bf856633600a62821b&_m=e167134957644e50b32dba83d2abb049&_e=x1JPudrC9dC70GnYLqmperd-XPwpd5lWiSZo9X7zVDItdKxw-36RlebtyYIQkJyxnErErW2u2rFli5HvGsfrkiwi-es7AqcggWmkp-KNtL8e59XdWmO6maIb26ZXjGfYqCgApfGumeUhUwGQyvBp_8riidzprJQKhQHvbR_RoRZA5YLDtTn2txyi_vphjwrWMCxS5pHsZ5p66ILBo1-wLXu3wG63eNqJTeknQgxH1_TznPRNAB2xJCA734C8QbL4U6BCRKQvUrLLyX1OoyinrgeJwT2DXAOI1_jyTRozBW2GjE4TXW8r5b8XS6QA_zwm)

America is worth the fight. While the Radical Left tries to destroy this country, Republicans, led by President Trump, will always fight to preserve our democracy.

[**So, if you can, please send my campaign a donation of any amount. This election cycle may be the most important in American history.**](http://links.banksforsenate.com/u/click?_t=588630feb05642bf856633600a62821b&_m=e167134957644e50b32dba83d2abb049&_e=x1JPudrC9dC70GnYLqmperd-XPwpd5lWiSZo9X7zVDItdKxw-36RlebtyYIQkJyxnErErW2u2rFli5HvGsfrkiwi-es7AqcggWmkp-KNtL8e59XdWmO6maIb26ZXjGfYqCgApfGumeUhUwGQyvBp_12Doxt5OInNn_ghaAqYyYNObCouar01Nng6HtlejNZDgNu69ShsB9XdPiRsCHJy2MylqSuWHesIi1GZ6_Bli958jXkZzdg0jAwz4BKoshBxljQ5ytd_cmLKF7YdnzuFBNKdnnCXINBvQCPcgVIusDRf4mzyZ39lmalRQtvBtslv)
